articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Twitter using Ordinal Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With around 186 million daily active users, Twitter is a popular social media platform with increasing user growth every year. The top three twitter markets are in the US, Japan, and India. Users tweet on various topics ranging from sports, politics, finance to entertainment. Twitter is also used by businesses to advertise their products and services. These tweets contain a vast amount of information that can be used in many different ways, from targeting advertisements, understanding customer sentiment, and analyzing users’ opinions about specific people or events. This research aims to apply sentiment analysis on Twitter data by Ordinal Regression. We use the twitter_samples from NLTK Corpus containing positive and negative tweets for our study. We use Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Multinomial Logistic Regression (MLR) classifiers to classify the tweet sentiment into five categories. Results show that this approach outperformed the related work in terms of accuracy. This improvement was possible by applying TextBlob to find the polarity of the tweets and using lemmatization instead of stemming.

articleTitle: Fruit Quality Recognition using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Fruit classification is essential in various industrial settings, such as factories, supermarkets, and other places. Fruit classification may also be beneficial to persons with unique nutritional needs who utilize it to choose the proper fruits. Manual sorting was formerly used for fruit classification is time-consuming and requires continual human presence. Many fruit classification machine learning techniques have been proposed in the past. Deep learning may be a powerful engine for generating actionable results in today’s reality because of its detection and classification abilities. As a result, a convolutional neural network was employed to construct an effective fruit classification model. It makes use of the fruits 360 dataset, which contains 131 different fruit and vegetable varieties. In this paper, we used three fruits, divided into three categories: good, raw, and damaged. The model was made in Keras. It had been trained for 50 epochs and had a 95% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Photonics Radar Modeling and Simulation in Opti-system Platform for High Resolution Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Since radar is created, the real time distance measurement, target recognition, Doppler shift frequency measurement, target’s velocity, angle of arrival measurements are the area of studies by the engineer and researcher. In the near past, development of photonics radar is very noteworthy. Its interference with the electromagnetic wave is very low as it works in the wide band. Before the hardware photonics radar setup the ground work for modeling and simulation is needed. In this paper we have made FMCW photonics radar in optisystem environment. The whole radar model for target detection is discussed and shown here. Besides, step by step every simulation result, from RF generation to photo detection has been shown in this paper.

articleTitle: Live Cricket Score Prediction Web Application using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cricket is an uncertain sport in which two teams compete against each other, and no Machine Learning model can predict the outcome with 100% accuracy. However, with some inputs such as conditions, required factors, circumstances, and past data, it is possible to predict an approximate score for either team or the match’s victor. As a result, analysts from the respective teams use all the available data and statistics to improve their team’s performance. Therefore, the authors have developed a web application for performing predictive analysis of a live T-20 match to predict the final score and to also predict the winner of the contest before the match begins. A live score scraper is also included in the app, which extracts accurate match data and loads it into the model for prediction. For a deeper understanding, the application allows to visualize the predictions using graphs. Algorithms such as Multivariate Polynomial Regression and Random Forest Classifier are used to make these predictions, while the web application is developed using Flask.

articleTitle: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition using CNN as Feature Extractor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper proposes the use of Convolutional Neural Networks as feature extractor for extraction of features from handwritten Devanagari characters. For classification, classifiers employed are SVM (Linear, Polynomial and RBF), KNN, RF, DT, MLP and XGB. Use of CNN model for feature extraction eliminates the need of handcrafted features by traditional pattern recognition methods. XGB Classifier, which is a very recent technique, has also been explored (which has not been done previously to the best of our knowledge). The experiments with these eight techniques have been done on the DHCD dataset proposed in year 2015. Use of CNN proved to be very effective for Devanagari characters recognition as all the models achieved recognition accuracy of over 92% and total training time including feature extraction and classification did not exceed a total of 12.16 minutes.

articleTitle: Classifier Comparison for Blind Source Separation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Source separation is important task in intelligibility for human as well as speech recognition system. The command from speech is required to be recognized for voice operated Internet of Things devices. The speech separation is complex task when number of noise sources increase with respect to room acoustics. The mixing of sounds and their separation is experimentation approach considered. The feature extraction is performed using 1D CNN model. The very less complex CNN model provides various in depth features which can be easily separated in the classifier. The model is proposed using recurrent neural network (RNN). The performance is evaluated and compared with other machine learning classifiers for classification of commands. The accuracy of more than 98% is seen with the use of proposed RNN model with combination of gated recurrent unit (GRU) and long short term memory (LSTM).

articleTitle: Development of Semi-autonomous Dragonfly based UAV in Free Flight Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The bioinspired quad wing propulsion resembling dragonfly insect-based unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is designed and developed. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles or Drones are technological platforms, with various applications starting from photography to agriculture, passenger drones to ambulances, surveillance drones to combat drones, infrastructure asset maintenance, and power lines inspection. These drones can vary from minimal size to those which carry a heavy payload. This bioinspired quad wing UAV capable of hovering and gliding at low Reynolds number is being developed. This UAV consists of four wings subjected to combined heaving and pitching motions for improved efficiency. These wings are controlled individually to enhance energy-efficient and results in maneuverability. These wings beat at the resonance frequency, thereby harnessing the vibrational energy of the wings and reduces the amount of power required to flap the wings. The flapping amplitude and frequency can be controlled individually or combined using a gear drive that enables variable frequency control or variable amplitude control, or both modes. In this study, the aerodynamic characteristics of propulsive forces are measured using a force sensor in free flight conditions and are compared with the conventional quadcopter UAV propeller characteristics. Preliminary experiments on kinematics and prototypes testing during free flight conditions are presented.

articleTitle: Automatic Room Sanitization Using UV-C Tubes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The current study intends to help in the battle against the transmission of COVID-19, a new human coronavirus, in any closed region of the study room, institution classroom, or laboratory. In this study, we used a NodeMCU to create a room sanitizing device based on Ultraviolet-C radiation. It operates in a completely automatic mode and does not need to be monitored on a continual basis. It features a motion detection security system that shuts off the designed system when activated; after a while, if no motion is detected, the system automatically switches back on. For experimental testing, the gadget is programmed to sanitize/ disinfect the room for 45, 15, 30, and 60 minutes, with 45 minutes being the default time setting. The method presented here can be scaled-up to provide greater ultraviolet doses by adding more UV-C tubes. This simple yet effective system is easy to set up and costs less than INR 3800. This device has various benefits over chemical based sanitizing procedures, including great efficacy due to the use of UV-C tubes.

articleTitle: Classification of Grape Leaf Disease Using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Pre-Trained Model VGG16
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Grape is an agricultural commodity that has high value with price in Indonesia is Rp 15,000 – Rp 60,000/Kgs. Plant disease is something that can decrease the productivity of the grape plant. Black rot, black measles, leaf blight are diseases that are often found on grape leaves. This disease has visible symptoms so farmers can take precautions. The process of identifying leaf disease is very important to determine what steps the farmers can take. With Technology utilization, the identification process becomes faster and more accurate. The total dataset is 1,801 divided into 4 classes and 3 categories of data and used Convolution Neural Network (CNN) with pre-trained VGG model. The result is very good because from this model obtained accuracy 97.9% and loss 6.5% for training data and 93.3% accuracy and loss 13% for validation data in the tenth epoch. In Testing analysis, the analysis using confusion matrix with every class has 8 images obtained 100% accuracy of recognize for class black rot, healthy leaf and leaf blight but 87.5% accuracy in black measles class, because only recognize 7 images from 8 images.

articleTitle: Image Classification Of Infected Potato Leaves Using Deep CNN Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The agricultural sector has an important role in Indonesia which can serve as the backbone of the economy, as well as supporting the food needs of the Indonesian people themselves. Therefore, research related to plant pathology by utilizing artificial intelligence continues to be developed to improve the quality and quantity of crop production in the agricultural sector. Related to plant pathology, this study aims to develop an image classification model on potato leaves by utilizing the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model that has been trained to perform image classification tasks or better known as transfer learning. The use of this technique is intended to reduce the problem of overfitting and computational load in the learning process using CNN modeling that was engineered from scratch. The results of this study indicate that the proposed image classification model can significantly reduce overfitting and computational load when compared to the CNN model development from the start. In the testing process, the proposed model also has much better accuracy, when compared to the CNN model development from scratch.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based System Design for Diabetes Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Amongst various chronic ailments, in recent years Diabetes became a diseases which is major cause of fatalities in today’s world. Therefore, a timely prediction of the symptoms of the diabetes significantly plays a great role in reduction of the mortality rate due to diabetes. Nowadays, a large amount of diabetes data is available in different data repositories such as the kaggle, MNIST and UCI. Diabetes is becoming majorly a world's most common, chronic, owing to complications, dreaded diseases. Diabetes must be detected early in order to receive appropriate treatment and to prevent the illness from progressing. Not only can the suggested approach to be utilized in forecasting incidence of diabetes in the future, however it can be applied to find out type of diabetes a person possesses. With various changes in treatment approaches between type 2 and type 1 diabetes, such schemes will aid in providing best therapy for patients. Our prototype is basically designed by applying concealed layers of a deep neural network and uses dropout regularization to avoid over fitting by converting job into a classification issue. We tuned a few parameters and utilised the binary cross-entropy loss function to create a high-accuracy deep neural network prediction model. The experimental findings demonstrate the efficacy and suitability of the proposed (Deep Learning for Diabetes Prediction) model. The Pima Indians diabetes data set has the best training accuracy of 98.07 percent. The Pima Indians diabetes and diabetic type databases have been subjected to extensive testing. The experimental findings demonstrate that our suggested model outperforms current techniques.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Using Deep Learning LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Stock market is well known to all. It is an option for investment and trading. But it is a really difficult thing to predict the future stock price. It is helpful for the investors and traders to know the future price, so that they can enter and exit the market at the right time and right price. Although there are different methods to predict future price, new algorithms and deep learning performed quite well in this. In this paper Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) is used to predict stock price and here we studied the implications of epochs and batch size in the model.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of a Smart Technique Five Level Inverter Based STATCOM to Mitigate Power Quality Issues
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) is among the greatest suggestive FACTS device which is a promising and substantial technology used to compensate shunt reactive power to control in transmission and distribution networks. The voltage source converter based STATCOM controllers are commercially introduced for controlling the system dynamics under unstable conditions. In last decades, STATCOM has been proposed different control strategies with different converter schemes for enhancing the performance of voltage source converter. Cascade multilevel H-bridge converter gives improved performance and results compare to other converters. This paper gives a Hardware Execution of Five Level Inverter Based STATCOM With PI Control Using Smart Technique with reactive power compensation of the system. Here the approach is automatic adjustment with the inverter. The efficiency of a multilevel based five level cascade H-bridge type of VSC is utilized as the VSC of STATCOM, as VSC is the key element of STATCOM.

articleTitle: Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease Using Machine Learning and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Alzheimer is a disease which is generally seen in people belonging to age group of 65 years and above. The Alzheimer disease is caused by the Excess secretion of $\beta-$amyloidal peptide $(\mathrm{A}\beta$) proteins between neurons. The current study is focused on ventricular space and total brain area, which will be less for persons with Non dementia and higher for Alzheimer patients. A comparative study is made to detect the Alzheimer based on Region of interest (ROI) technique which utilizes image processing for classification. And Machine learning (ML) + image processing based Technique on MRI images for classification purpose. The input images were preprocessed for contrast equalization and noise reduction purpose, then ventricular space of Alzheimer’s and Non-Alzheimer image were calculated in the form of ratio which will be acting as deciding factor in the “Decision tree“ Algorithm. Ventricular volume for Alzheimer patients will be greater than Non dementia patients, acting as deciding factor. Present technique has been tested with confusion matrix for accuracy where we got up to 95 % accurate results. This has got upper hand to other technique which is able to give 86% accuracy using Region of interest (ROI) based technique. This technique can be used in medical field for detecting Disease in patients.

articleTitle: Novel Two Time Scale Observer based Sliding Mode Control with Velocity Estimator for Magnetic Levitation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this article, a robust sliding mode control (SMC) using a novel Two-Time Scale (TTS) observer and a combined state and disturbance observer (SDO) is proposed for magnetic levitation (Maglev) application. Maglev system comprises of an electrical subsystem and an electromechanical subsystem. The SDO is intended to evaluate the unknown state and disturbances simultaneously for electromechanical loop while TTS is proposed to estimates disturbances in electrical loop. Lyapunov stability criteria are used to show that the controller is stable. An extensive simulation and hardware validation is performed to prove the effectiveness of proposed control law.

articleTitle: Comparative Study Of Impact Of COVID-19 Lockdown On AQI Parameters Across Urban India
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the midst of the COVID-19 outbreak, India imposed a state-wise lockdown due to which pollution levels in major cities across the nation decrease drastically. The current study used a variety of pollution metrics (PM10, PM2.5, SO2, NO2, CO, O3, and NH3) to reveal geographical air quality patterns before and during the lockdown. The findings revealed that during a lock-down, air quality increases significantly. India suffered significant economic losses as a result of the shutdown, but it did relieve the environment. The goal of this study is to determine the effects of lockdown on air quality in 26 major Indian cities. A significant reduction in the concentration of PM2.5/PM10 levels is observed as compared to the other pollutant levels. O3 concentration is higher between 2017–2019 as compared to the lockdown phase. Delhi observed the drastic change in pollution level going from the very poor category to the good category. In general, the study is believed to be a useful input to regulatory agencies because it demonstrates that reducing pollution sources can improve air quality. Temporary source control can help cure the environment for a limited time.

articleTitle: An Efficient Neural Network-based MPPT technique for PV Array Under Partial Shading Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A recent approach i.e. Maximum Power point tracking (MPPT) under partial shading conditions (PSC) is becoming popular. This paper comprises experimental evaluations of the P & O method, incremental inductance method & a method based on artificial neural network (ANN).The use of such MPPT methods guarantees, the extraction of most of the power from the solar panels array. A suitable combination with set of panels connected in series to meet voltage requirements, wholly connected in parallel with such other sets to meet the large current requirements. For comparison among different methods, results show that the P & O method & IC method shows high errors in tracking peak power point, while tracking of Global MPPT (GMPTT) is feasibly done by ANN-based approach.

articleTitle: Prototype implementation of Atmospheric Water Generation by Peltier Device
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The efficiency of an Atmospheric Water Generator(AWG) with two Thermoelectric Coolers – Peltier Devices – is experimentally investigated to understand its practical feasibility. The experimental setup is designed to be a Portable device that utilizes minimum amount of energy, makes use of two Thermoelectric Devices along with air flow regulation. The aim of the study is to understand the effect of ambient air temperature, Relative Humidity and air flow velocity on the amount of Water generated. The study also aims to investigate the change in Water generation and efficiency by varying the area of the condensation surface. The change in available area has a positive effect on water generation but inhibits the further condensation due to crystallization effect. The study also aims to experimentally determine the increase in Water generation upon the use of a pointed extended fin type surface for increasing the condensation area

articleTitle: Power optimisation Scheme for Electric Vehicle using Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The transportation sector plays a vital role globally. Energy efficiency in transportation is traced in terms of fuel consumption i.e. battery or electricity in case of electric vehicle. The main intention of this paper is to address analysis of control strategies and optimisation techniques for enhancing the performance of induction motor (IM) drives used in EV. IM works efficiently following loss minimization and preferably used due to high stability as well as low cost. As this paper is concerning the enhancement of IM performance, conventional PID control strategy is used in the beginning followed by optimization by replacing PID with fuzzy logic controller (FLC). In PID control method, speed parameters are compared to generate an error which is reduced with the help of PID block to eventually generate torque. This torque along with flux produces reactive component of current $(\mathrm{i}_{\mathrm{s}\mathrm{q}})$. On the other hand, in second strategy, the conventional PID method is replaced with intelligent control technique FLC. Both the algorithms are examined in MATLAB/Simulink software and the outputs are compared, implying that FLC gives better performance than PID in terms of speed, torque and current with respect to time. The performance of FLC highly depends on fuzzy rules and MF variables, which are determined by trial and error procedure.

articleTitle: A Context Aware Embedding for the Detection of Hate Speech in Social Media Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Proliferation of social media platforms in recent past has resulted into upsurge in the number of users. Advent of these sites have paved way for the users to easily express share and communicate. In such a scenario, it is imperative to analyze the content and identify nasty content so as to avoid unpleasant situations. Machine learning techniques are extensively used for this purpose. In this paper, we propose a language model for the identification of hate speech in twitter data. Distil-BERT, a context aware embedding model along with Support Vector Machine (SVM) for the classification of hate speech has been used. SVM with a 10-fold cross validation and linear kernel has been found to provide better accuracy as compared to existing models. Results show that accuracy is improved with the use of context aware embedding model.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Analysis and diagnosis has a major importance in the medical Industry. Timely diagnosis plays a very crucial role whenever lives of the patient are concerned. Pneumonia is sometimes fatal lung infection which can be fatal many times so an early and efficient diagnosis with high accuracy is required. Real life method of detecting pneumonia are very trivial so there is need for a system by using deep-learning has been a driving force for making this project. In this paper, we propose different deep convolutional neural network(CNN) architectures to extract features from images of chest X-ray and classify the images to detect presence pneumonia in a person with a higher accuracy. For this research work we have used the real world dataset contributed by the National library of medicine for research work. Through this paper we want to show that with the help of deep learning can help us in detecting disease in early stages which makes it ideal for treatment, which was not possible in the early era of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Advanced Plant Disease Detection By Using Tensorflow
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This research work entitled “Plant Disease Detection by using TensorFlow” which focus on farmer’s basic problem. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. Every year farmers of Bangladesh produce huge amounts of crops and fully depend on them. But it is not so easy to take care of crops. Many diseases can harmfully affect crops. Most of the time that cannot identify those diseases and cannot take proper steps to solve problems. Now everything became smart and technology-dependent. The use of Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning is everywhere. Following this, a system is built. A system that is smart, fast and that system can identify the diseases of crops. CNN model and Tensor Flow library are used to classifying the diseases of crops. This system can make work easy with big farms to identify the disease of trees or crops.

articleTitle: Underwater Wireless Optical Communication - A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Underwater Optical Communication System came into Figure is because of its high data rate transmission over the distance up to several 10’s of meters through a Water medium using the optical signals. Data transmission in Underwater medium can be performed in 3 ways i.e., through Radio frequency (RF) signals, Optical signals and Acoustic signals. But when we differentiate between the Acoustic signals, RF signals, and Optical signals, The optical signals provide much higher bandwidth thus facilitates higher data rate. Many potential applications can be performed using UWOC systems such as Environment monitoring, offshore applications, deep ocean explorations, disaster precaution and naval applications. Apart from all of these advantages, one major challenge is in UWOC systems is its severe attenuation of optical signals in Underwater due to absorption and scattering. In order to vanquish these problems in optical communication, different approaches were introduced for UWOC systems in recent years.

articleTitle: Impacts of Rotating-Type DG Sources on Power System Stability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The idea of meeting increased power demand at a load centre by a distributed generation (DG) source employing locally available energy resources has attracted much attention in power system research. The growth and development of DG is driven by environmental, regulatory and commercial factors. Although DG technology offers many technical benefits, there are certain issues that need to be addressed. The impact of DG penetration on power system stability is one such issue that requires further investigation. The main objective of this article is to analyze the impact of the rotational type of DGs on small-signal and transient stability of power system. The results of critical damping ratio and timedomain indicators are analyzed and discussed. The results indicate that increasing the DG penetration level beyond an optimum value can degrade the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Mobility Aware Handover Execution Model for Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Modern (Internet of Things) IoT applications requires seamless connectivity with high reliability; thus the IoT device are connected to heterogeneous wireless network by integrating LTE and mmWave network. mmWave offers better bandwidth and less latencies for achieving high p[performance]. However, due to direction antenna and high dependencies on cloud lead to coverage blindness/hotspot and interference problems. The IoT device are mobile in nature and is powered by batteries; poor handover execution will lead to wastage of energy. Thus, this paper present mobility aware handover execution (MAHE) algorithm by reducing signaling overhead through XGBoost machine learning algorithm. Further, for mitigating interference obstacle aware path loss component is considered. Experiment outcome shows the MAHE model achieves better handover success rate, less handover failure, and better throughput when compared with standard handover execution methodology.

articleTitle: Redacting Sensitive Information from the Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Redaction of personal, confidential and sensitive information from documents is becoming increasingly important for individuals and organizations. In past years, there have been many well-publicized cases of data leaks from various popular companies. When the data contains sensitive information, these leaks pose a serious threat. To protect and conceal sensitive information, many companies have policies and laws about processing and sanitizing sensitive information in business documents.The traditional approach of manually finding and matching millions of words and then redacting is slow and error-prone. This paper examines different models to automate the identification and redaction of personal and sensitive information contained within the documents using named entity recognition. Sensitive entities example person’s name, bank account details or Aadhaar numbers targeted for redaction, are recognized based on the file’s content, providing users with an interactive approach to redact the documents by changing selected sensitive terms.

articleTitle: Advanced Social Internet of Things for Real Time Monitoring of Diabetics Patient in Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Health monitoring has become a crucial aspect in this modern era of society. Various traditional approaches being used in this has their own limitations in terms of data collection and data transfer across public networks. With the advancements in IoT for cloud platforms, many of the research is being carried out in this area. In our proposed model, we accumulate the various parameters of the patients such as pulse rate, glucose level, temperature and blood pressure using Ardunio UNO. The collected data is preprocessed to compute the dominating features resulting for diabetics using Principal Component Analysis (PCA). These features are pushed to the public cloud in real time and machine learning models can be used to notify the patients and hospital authorities for the severity of the patient. In our experiment we have used Support Vector Machine as Training Model. The experiments resulted with an accuracy of upto 96.80%.

articleTitle: Analysing and Predicting Air Quality In Delhi: Comparison of Industrial and Residential Area
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Inspecting, preventing, and controlling air pollution has become one of the most essential and relevant activities in many urban and industrial cities of many nations today. Air pollution and its hazardous contents pose a threat not only to humans but also to the entire flora and fauna. With increasing levels of air pollution, we are in dire need of a model that monitors and predicts the Air quality index (PM2.5, PM10,O3, NO2, SO2, CO) over a period of time. This paper proposes a scientific contribution to this challenge. We have implemented different Machine learning algorithms like XGBoost, Random Forest, Facebook prophet, and Recurrent neural network (RNN) to forecast pollutants and particulate levels and at the same time to predict the AQI. The dataset collected is for the years 2018 and 2019 from different measurement stations in metropolitan and industrial area of Delhi city, India. The efficiency and accuracy of these supervised learning algorithms are promising and can help the meteorological department in predicting air quality.

articleTitle: Fungus Detection and Identification using Computer Vision Techniques and Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this paper we have presented a fungus detection system. As we all know that Fungus is a very big risk for the human Life as it can come in contact to humans through food, water, Air etc. Exposure to high concentrations of fungal spores from air can cause many health problems, such as bronchial asthma and other deadly diseases. Fungus is the main risk for food logistics. We aim to build a model which can correctly detect and identity fungus. Datasets plays a critical role throughout the procedure. For detection purposes, an accurate dataset is required. The dataset we are collecting was made using an optical acquisition system. The main task of our project is the image analysis. Image analysis can be done using computer vision techniques or with the help of machine learning. We have explained both the methods of analysis of CVT using Histogram oriented gradients (HOG) and Support Vector Machine and Convolution neural networks (CNN) in detail with various processes and layers involved.

articleTitle: Lyapunov-Krasovskii Based Stability Analysis of SSSP Grid Connected Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this paper, MFA(Multi Frequency Averaging) based dynamic phasor model is approached for modelling the SSSP(Single Stage Single Phase) grid connected photovoltaic systems mathematically and stability analysis for MFA based dynamic phasor model of SSSP grid connected photovoltaic system is done using Krasovskii approach based on Lyapunov second method. MFA based dynamic phasor model deals with extensive details of dynamics present in the system and provides better analysis and accuracy in this mathematical model approach. Krasovskii approach based on Lyapunov function is preferred to analyse the stability of dynamic phasor mathematical model for different switching frequencies. Thus the dynamic phasor mathematical approach is verified using Matlab/SIMULINK software tool.

articleTitle: Low Noise And Low Power Transimpedance Amplifier using Inverter Based Local Feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The large data that needs to be transferred has led to an high usage of optical communication systems. In optical communication system Transimpedance amplifiers (TIA) plays a very important role. TIA are used at thr receiver side of optical communication system to convert the current obtained from photodiode to amplified voltage Thus obtained appropriate voltage signal is processed in further stages of communication system. A TIA should have high bandwidth and low power consumption but due to large photodiode capacitance it is difficukt to achieve. This paper presents a transimpedance amplifier (TIA) circuit with high gain and wide bandwidth with vey low noise effect. Author has used inverter based feedback system with always on PMOS and NMOS to reduce the leakage current for nanoelectronics application and increase the bandwidth for wide band and high-speed application. With this topology achieved -3db bandwidth is 8.2 GHz with high gain of 53.2dBohms. The noise effect is 23.36pA/sqHz i.e very low compared to other topologies in 180nm design. The author had used current mirror instead of constant current source thus power dissipation is also very low i.e 3.6mW. Thus this TIA can be used efficiently in low power high band 10Gb/s applications

articleTitle: Robust Drive Controlling System Based on Road Sign Detection for Low-Resolution Images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A driver assistance system monitors and alerts the driver continuously about the traffic signs, reducing the chance of accidents due to neglecting or misinterpreting traffic signs. It is a computerized approach with a minimal error rate. The proposed model continuously searches for a traffic sign, estimates its predefined meaning, and alerts the driver to make the decision accordingly. The model architecture processed the German Traffic Sign dataset using 2D-Convolution layers combined with dropout, max pooling and got 99.022% test accuracy. This proposed model can be integrated with advanced driver-assistance systems to aid the driver and prevent accidents due to neglecting or misinterpreting traffic signs.

articleTitle: Classification of Acoustic Data Using the FF Neural Network and Random Forest Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: According to their acoustic analysis, speaker identification systems are intended to identify the speaker or group of speakers. Many methods are used to conduct acoustic analysis on a speech signal, with time and frequency domain analysis being the most common. The MFCC and Fundamental Frequency techniques are used in this article to extract acoustic information from speech samples. Two distinct methods, Random-forest and Feed Forward Neural Network, are used to classify the findings. The combination of the FFNN classifier with the acoustic model yielded a recognition accuracy of 91.4 percent. This paper makes use of the CMU ARCTIC Database.

articleTitle: An Approach to Design and Implement Parallel Web Crawler
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Indefinite cyberspace crawling is an architecture for a parallel searching process occurred in various websites using internet. Web crawler is defined as a software or program which traverses the Web and downloads web documents in an automated manner. It’s depends on the type of questions asked by the user. The pertinence of Web Crawler in the field of web search of this architecture is to capably and successfully crawl the current set of publicly index able web pages to amplify the download rate on shrinking the parallelization. Now a days web grows is becoming extremely difficult to recover the substantial or significant portion of the Web using in a single method. There are many search engines like-Google, Bing, Yandex, Search Encrypt etcetera runs various threads in parallel to perform the above job, so that the download rate gets exploited. The requirement of web crawler is to gather and verify the data in order to store the huge amount of data in such a speed on the Web requires parallel computing. It is definite as a program or as a software that traverses the Website and downloads web documents in a systematic, robotic method. We are going to discuss about the relevance of the Web Crawler. The topic about web crawler is the option to do web search and a small examination on Web Crawler on different problematic fields or domains in web search as mention here.

articleTitle: Reduction of Harmonics in 25kV Line of Electric Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Railways are one of the most feasible and economic modes of transportation in our country. As the demand is increasing, it is difficult to provide power with good quality since the non-linear loads induce harmonics that are going to affect the power grid, power factor, etc. Non-linear loads that are used in the locomotives induce harmonics back into the line. As a result of this, the motor’s life and efficiency are affected. An Active and Passive filter can be integrated to form a Hybrid filter. And this filter along with synchronous (d-q) reference frame theory-based controller is the core area of this work. MATLAB computer simulation is used as a tool. Hybrid filter is used to cease harmonics and therefore simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK model so that the THD% is regulated under the guidelines of IEEE-519 standards.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Models for Devanagari OCR
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Emergence of Deep Learning Approaches have led to major breakthroughs and improvement in image classification tasks. Handwritten character recognition is one such area where the deep learning methods are employed for enhanced performance. This paper reviews the state-of-the-art deep learning methods viz. CNN, ANN, Capsule Network, Residual Network, and Transfer Learning Networks that are pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset— AlexNet, DenseNet, VGG, Inception used for recognition of the handwritten characters of Devanagari script. The paper presents an exhaustive comparison of all mentioned techniques both in terms of qualitative and quantitative analysis. The paper also highlights the challenges, and future directions for Devanagari characters recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dielectric Lens-Shell Antennas using Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Radiation analysis through dielectric lens with shell illuminated by microstrip patch array antenna using hybrid method is presented in this paper. The hybrid of FEM (Finite Element Method) used in Ansys HFSS and Geometrical Optics (GO) is employed for the analysis. The radiation pattern of primary radiator is first computed in HFSS and later this field is further used for Ray tracing through the lens using GO. The low loss dielectric lens-shell antennas of hemispherical and hemispheroidal shapes are considered for the analysis. The lens and shell combination acts as a radome and also enhance the directive gain of the primary radiator. The lens-shell antennas are illuminated by $2\times 2$ Microstrip Patch Antenna (MPA) Array. The gain enhancement of 3dB is observed due to lens collimation. To validate the results of hybrid method, the simulation of dielectric lens-shell with patch array is accomplished in HFSS and the results are compared. The results indicate a good agreement between hybrid method and HFSS. The time required for computation of radiated fields using the proposed hybrid technique is a fraction of time that required by EM flow solver for the considered system resources. The developed analysis could be used for larger and various shapes of dielectric lens shells.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Comparative Analysis Of Single Carrier PWM Schemes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to design, simulate and generate Verilog codes for digital PWM techniques for sinusoidal pulse width modulation and third-harmonic PWM injection with different carriers for a three-level voltage source inverter using Xilinx system generator. The built-in FPGA architecture to generate PWM pulses is used.

articleTitle: A Bridgeless Isolated Zeta Converter for Battery Charging Aided with Solar Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The idea of assisting solar PV in onboard battery charging system improves reliability of system consequently less burden on grid and improvement in per mile cost of vehicle is achieved and so an assisted charging system including bridgeless isolated Zeta converter as power factor correction (PFC) unit is introduced here. The converter operation is ensured in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) for wide operating range whereas CUK converter having continuous output and input current features is used in solar PV is utilized efficiently for obtaining maximum power from solar PV. Further when the grid outage occurs, additional benefits include continuous battery charging, supply voltage control for wide variation. Also, system is observed at various irradiations in solar PV and results are presented here. Supply current is improved by using PFC and absence of diode bridge rectifier in bridgeless isolated Zeta converter makes it ripple free circuit by reducing switching stresses thereby decreasing Total harmonic distortion (THD) value to standard acceptable range i.e., below 5% showing improved and efficient charging system. Cascaded PI control is used to ensure the closed loop operation in PFC converter while solar PV uses the MPPT algorithm as P&O to extract the maximum of power from the PV panel and ensuring the continuity of battery charging in smooth way. Moreover, the PFC converter circuit uses CC-CV charging. The proposed system is validated using MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Scalable Cloud Environment using iDR
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The Cloud Environment is an integration of mixed-type workflow with heterogeneous computing resources. Experiment with a real cloud environment is required for testing, capacity planning, and performance evaluation for cloud hosting applications. However, some limitations exist on experimental studies, i.e., actual cloud experiments are too expensive, not covered in all situations, do not cover all functions. The iDR simulation tool is an alternate of actual cloud experiments. Simulation using iDR is a method to estimate cloud resources based on synthetic cloud workload. The iDR is a toolkit of methods and processes to simulate a cloud environment with several dimensions, i.e., performance, costing, energy consumption, environmental impact, and reliability in a single GUI platform. In this paper, we illustrate iDR simulation toolkit that enables modeling and simulation of Cloud Computing Environments.

articleTitle: Assessment of Source, Medium, and Intercommunication for Assessing the Credibility of Content
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Information available on internet does have any way to evaluate the quality of a content. There is no control on the creation and consumption of the content. Trust on user generated content is the first impression on the user based on their beliefs. The content creators have the analysis of the clear understanding of the belief system of the user (User’s interest, sentiments). There is a challenge to truly assess the content, interaction with content, source of the information and their minute specifications.Assessment of the quality of the content and define a mechanism to define the credibility is still an open issue. In this research paper the parameter affecting the credibility, are identified. The extent of affection along with the criterion to validate the mechanism is also discussed in this paper.Experiment is performed on a Movie dataset; features are extracted, and assessment of source medium and interaction is calculated. The novel content credibility evaluation method is evaluated using precision, Recall and F-Measure. The accuracy of proposed module is 89 %.

articleTitle: Design, Implementation and Monitoring of the Performance of Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of the Li-ion battery model while charging and discharging and its implementation into the Hybrid Electric Vehicle. The HEV design presented utilises Fuel Cells and a battery pack. To charge the battery pack, the basic design of Solar PV system and Wind Turbine System is also presented which can be used for charging the battery pack or to supply the electricity to the grid. Through the simulation of these models, the paper presents the analysis of various electrical parameters and focuses on improving the battery’s life span and its state of charge (SOC). The HEV model can also be used to do the behavioural analysis for various types of different practical situations.

articleTitle: Hash Constructions for CoAP under an IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Hash construction is a very famous method. This is popular because the hash function is found in almost all security algorithms. Various uses of hash functions have been found since the early stages of computing and communication. The most fascinating thing of a hash construction is its one way property. One way property of a hash function has been used in many places for example, generating security key for two party communications and creating a digital signature to safeguard an important document. The hash functions are in use from very long, i.e. when the Uninterrupted Power Supply (UPS) based machines were communicated. Even at that time also the hash functions were of three types, i.e. MD, SHA and BLAKE. When it comes to lightweight computing, i.e. communicating machines without direct power supply or with stored energy only, the hash function is considered to be the best. A new design of hashing based on a sponge construction is proposed for the secure communication between constrained devices in lightweight fashion. There were many other developments in this field occurred before the sponge construction comes into existence those are JH, Keccak, BLAKE and SHA. Although there are a huge number of hash constructions are available, the original need of a lightweight IoT environment is still not fulfilled. In this presented paper, the authors will discuss all working methodology for hash constructions along with their positive and negative aspects. Also, a fair comparison of several hash design has be given for the easiness of its users.

articleTitle: Automated Waste Segregation using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The key to efficient waste management is to ensure segregation of waste and resource recovery. Waste is usually segregated on the basis of whether it is biodegradable or non biodegradable. A major challenge with respect to this is that waste materials are not segregated before collection and discarded nonetheless. These end up as huge piles of waste in dump yards and need to be segregated. Waste segregation is currently being done manually by the Municipal Corporation. This results in unsanitary working conditions for the people who need to perform this task. Despite being provided with the necessary equipment, they run the risk of catching infections from the waste they work with. Automation of this process will be beneficial for the people who work on this by reducing health hazards.

articleTitle: Image based Road distress detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Infrastructure plays an important role in the development of any nation. Roads are very important for the movement of humans and goods. Good road infrastructure reduces travel time and cost. Poor road infrastructure can cause an increase in travel time, more consumption of fuel and lead to accidents due to difficulty in driving. All these factors will have a cascading effect on the economy as the prices of essential commodities are directly related to the easy of transportation. Hence, it is necessary to detect the distresses on roads like potholes and do regular repairs. Initially, manual inspection was done by the concerned employers, who go check the roads and take note of the areas where there is a requirement of repair. This method involves a lot of time and labor. With the development in technology, the focus on implementing a smart method of inspection increased. To build an accurate and quick detection system, an Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) based model is proposed in this paper. This algorithm finds the presence of road distress by comparing the image of the current testing road with that of the reference image. The experiment also considers the chance of occurrence of Gaussian noise and Salt and Pepper noise while capturing the images, to fit the real-world situations.

articleTitle: LPWAN’s – Overview, Market Scenario and Performance Analysis of Lora, Sigfox Using NB-Fi Range Calculator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT), has witnessed the growth of the Low Power Wireless Area Networks (LPWAN). The capabilities of LPWAN’s are playing the important role in connecting devices. Proper selection of the LPWAN’s technologies plays important role in implementation. LPWAN includes LoRa, Sigfox, Narrow Band-Internet of Things (NB-IoT), Long Term Evolution for Machines (LTE-M) etc. This paper presents an overview of work done related to LPWAN Technologies. In this paper we presented the LPWAN market scenario. Strong momentum has observed in LPWAN market worldwide. The performance of the LPWAN Technologies such as LoRa and Sigfox is discussed. NB-Fi -range-calculator is used for theoretical performance analysis.

articleTitle: RNA Sequence Based Prediction of Coronavirus Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The detection of the virus is a basic concern for the doctors and the virology for over a decades due to the dynamic behavior and mutations of the virus makes it difficult to detect the virus and study its behaviors. Latest computational techniques enables scientists to crate models that are proficient of learning patterns from the data as well as used to make predictions for unseen data.. As machine learning techniques predicts the corona viruses by allowing for their differing genetic purposeful characteristics, we propose machine learning supported coronavirus prediction method Novel-COV-2 Predictor wherever RNA sequences of SARSCoV-1, MERS, and SARS-CoV-2 are used to instruct a classifier so that it can expect any indefinite sequence of these viruses. The RNA sequence is given in the form of the large text files. Consequently, it becomes a text classification complexity. We convert these data in the text files into numerical data using the count vectorization and utilize machine learning to create a model to know the patterns. In this regard, we have considered Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm to evaluate and so that SARSCoV-2 can be predicted as untimely as potential to save human life.

articleTitle: ASL Tutor Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Sign Language is used by people with speech impairment and it improves the individual ability to efficiently communicate with the world. Although Sign Language has become conventional lately, the main drawback persists that there is still a gap between the disabled and the enabled, which is blatantly ignored due to its given insignificance. The goal of this work is to create a vision-based application that helps in tutoring the American Sign Language (ASL) to the common crowd and thus shortening this communication gap. The proposed object detection model takes an image input and extracts the temporal features which are then processed by a custom YOLO-Tiny architecture model. This approach uses the Object Detection techniques for this application where most of the research is done using Image Classification techniques. In the end, the user’s actions are tested by the model based on how similar the action is to the relevant gesture.

articleTitle: New Frontiers in Solar Power Generation: A Comprehensive Review of Solar Power Satellite Schemes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The earth continuously receives around 173 quadrillion watts (173000 billion kW) of solar energy, which is close to 10,000 times more than the world’s power consumption as of 2020. Though solar energy directed towards earth seems promising, hurdles like the lack of space for building plants close to areas of usage, or transmission costs and losses from the large-scale energy generation units (like solar farms) make reaching the goal more difficult and time-consuming than estimated. With rapidly rising global energy demands, it is of prime importance to develop novel techniques to harness energy in more efficient ways. Thus, the question lies in how to harness solar energy without an added disturbance to densely populated regions, reducing transmission costs, and also overcoming the irregularity in power generated due to irregular weather patterns. This work is a comprehensive review of the available solar power satellite schemes as a solution for the projected energy crisis.

articleTitle: An Efficient System to Quantify Error in Sensor Fusion for Cameras in ADAS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Sensor fusion is the process of acquiring and fusing data from two different sensors for environment perception. With the increase in the level of automation needed for almost all the systems, depth perception has become an integral part of environment perception. There are various sensors available for the same, but most of them are expensive and provide insufficient data. This paper describes in detail the sensor fusion of two cameras for depth perception. The use of cameras not only allows the user to calculate depth, it also opens up a new dimension of using machine learning algorithms because of the availability of image frames. The depth of an object is calculated using the triangulation method. The paper focuses on the use of triangulation methods for depth analysis and it is used along with ultrasonic sensors for quantifying the error. A comparative analysis of the results obtained from the cameras, the sensor, and the actual distance has led to quantifying the error. Use of cameras for depth perception helps to eliminate the use of extra sensors, thereby reducing the complexity and cost, and thus increasing the efficiency.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Grid Interactive PV system with PLL Controlled Three Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Micro grids are a self-sufficient energy distribution system unique for every geographic situation comprising mostly of nonconventional sources of energy i.e. renewables like solar, wind, tidal, small running hydro, etc. in combination with energy storage devices like battery banks and super capacitors, acting as a single controllable unit with respect to the grid. In this developed three phase grid connected PV based micro grid main objective is, the control of three phase inverter supplied by the DC power generated by photovoltaic array and to obtain a grid synchronized output by the renewable resource. This paper implements a MATLAB 17a Simulink micro grid model consisting of a 100kW PV array, whose maximum power point is tracked by Perturb and Observe algorithm, controlling the DC boost chopper duty ratio, to supply a constant voltage to the Voltage Source Inverter connected to the grid controlled by Phase Locked Loop controller. This manuscript helps us to understand and develop the simulated results generating the desired power, voltage and frequency outputs with limited Total Harmonic Distortions of a PV based micro grid connected to a three phase grid via Voltage Source Inverter. The main highlight is the synchronous three Phase Locked Loop triggering mechanism developed for the grid connected inverter switches.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Social Networks using Histogram Based Gradient Boosting Regression Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Social Networks play an important role in today’s world and applications range from a connected world to uncovering important relationships in bio-logical systems. The enormous rise in the application of social networks has resulted in the importance of detecting the relationships between the nodes even before they are formed. Several approaches have been proposed in the past specifically for the task of link prediction using various indices. There has been a tremendous effort in merging various indices using machine learning concepts and analogy of Law of Gravitation using similarity measures as a proxy for distance and popularity measures as a proxy of mass. The merging of several indices can increase the overall effectiveness of link prediction and very few algorithms have been suggested in past. In this work, we propose the use of a “Histogram based Gradient Boosting Regression Tree” for the task of link prediction after unifying three popularity and four similarity measures.

articleTitle: Tamper Detection using Self-Generating Watermarks based on Local Binary Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Image watermarking is a technique used for versatile applications. This paper proposes a blind spatial domain fragile watermarking technique that aims at detecting tamper and distortion caused due to intentional or unintentional attacks. The image is first divided 4 equal sections and 2 pairs are formed. These pairs are together used for tamper localization. Each section is then divided into $4 \times 4$ blocks. For every sub-block, the average of 4 inner pixels is calculated. Using this average value, local binary pattern (LBP) is generated for the sub-block using the 12 boundary pixels. A 4-bit watermark is self-generated from the LBP and embedded into the sub-block. The same watermark is also embedded into corresponding section pair to ensure better tamper detection. The method is tested against a variety of attacks like copy-paste, copy-move, blurring, cropping, etc. and shows efficiency in detecting tampered regions.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of ANFIS-PSO based grid integration using Improved SOGI-FLL Algorithm under fluctuating solar irradiance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents an integrated method of adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system-particle swarm optimization (ANFIS–PSO) with an Improved Second Order Generalized Integrator-Frequency Locked Loop (ISOGI-FLL) to obtain a new MPPT strategy for achieving swift and maximum power tracking in PV systems with a reduced number of oscillations. The ANFIS-PSO approach does not require any additional sensors for measuring irradiance. The Improved Second order generalized integrator-frequency locked loop generates controlled signals for the voltage source converter (VSC). The presented approach is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment and its performance is validated with the steepest descent MPPT results.

articleTitle: Smart Grievance Redressal System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Addressing the grievances of citizens is a tough task for an administration. Classifying and prioritizing the grievances will make the grievance redressal system more efficient. This paper proposes a software application to identify common issues by analysing multiple grievances, so as to provide the administration, with a view of the important issues that require immediate attention. The software application is developed using state of the art NLP technologies to implement text classification, keyword extraction and keyword clustering on the set of grievances.

articleTitle: BM25 Algorithm Driven Search Tool for Linking Exploits to Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The vulnerability monitoring and prioritizing could be challenging for enterprise security stakeholders. With a number of vulnerabilities published regularly, few of the vulnerabilities result in real-life attacks. However, no matter how slight the possibility of vulnerabilities could result in an exploit, proactive attention is given to vulnerability related information by the cybersecurity community. Researchers aim to consolidate the information regarding vulnerabilities, including but not limited to CVSS, vulnerability description, vulnerability mentioned on a different platform including social media platforms, dark web. The presented work in this paper is motivated to map released vulnerabilities to exposed exploits and vice versa. The mapping could result in one of the features to approximate the possibility of exploiting a vulnerability. The proposed work is accomplished in the form of a search tool to find relevant vulnerabilities for the given exploit title and vice versa

articleTitle: Chest CT Image Super Resolution using Deep Learning Network Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Image Super Resolution is a process of converting a Low Resolution image into High Resolution image with better visual quality and improved details. It is one of the most popular technique in image processing and computer vision. Super Resolution is applied in wide range of real world applications like medical imaging, surveillance applications and reconstruction of high quality remote sensing images. In the recent years, Super Resolution using deep learning techniques significantly improved accuracy. In this paper, Implemented four deep learning network models to generate High Resolution images of chest CT scans and evaluated the quantitative measure Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio to compare accuracy of each CNN based deep leaning network models such as Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN), Enhanced Deep Super-Resolution (EDSR), Very Deep Super-Resolution (VDSR) and Deep Recursive Convolutional Network (DRCN).

articleTitle: Deep Convolutional Neural Network to Handle Saturation in Image Deblurring
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Deep neural network techniques are being developed to extract sharp edges from fuzzy photos for kernel estimation. The formulation is based on conventional models, but it has limits and is likely to fail when the blurred images contain a large number of outliers, such as saturated regions. For deblurring photos, several neural networks have been constructed that do not address outliers, while non-neural network algorithms have been designed to manage saturation alone. Few smoothing techniques, edge enhancing filters technique are used as an image pre-processing stage before the deconvolution process, but they don't manage saturated pixels, resulting in ringing artifacts and poor deblurring outcomes. In this work, a masking technique is introduced at pre-processing stage to handle saturation effectively in prior to Deep Convolutional Neural Network for image deblurring. The results show the reduced ringing artifacts and considerable improvements with the performance of existing deep deblur networks.

articleTitle: A High CMRR OTA Design with Capacitively Coupled Ripple Reduction Methodology for Biomedical Acquisition Systems using 18nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The design and analysis of high CMRR ($\gt$100dB) telescopic operational transconductance amplifier with the introduction to ripple reduction loop consuming very low power of 2nW is presented using 18nm CMOS technology. This improved ripple reduction technique resulted in suppressing the ripples to a mean value of S5.45$\mu$V and input referred noise to 12.S31(nV/sqrtHz) with minimal power, area and overheads. The simulation results are taken using Tanner EDA tool.

articleTitle: Career Recommender System Using Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With so many career opportunities present in the computer science field, it becomes pretty tedious for individuals to identify their strengths and goals. This study aims to form a relationship between the experiences of an individual and determine the best suitable career path in the computer science field. Decision trees are used to categorize and organize several disciplines of computer science. According to the data analysis findings, some domains are more likely to be pursued by students since they have comparable academic and professional interests. According to the study results, there is a positive relationship between excellent experiences and career trajectories.

articleTitle: A Template for Alternative Proof of Work for Cryptocurrencies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Many popular cryptocurrencies, such as Bitcoin, form consensus through a method known as Proof of Work. Problematically, current implementations of Proof of Work require immense amounts of energy consumption, where a majority of this energy is spent solely on securing consensus. Our focus is not to directly decrease energy consumption, but to allow for more useful and pragmatic computation to come from Proof of Work, such that energy is saved by not running these computational tasks separately. In this paper, we create a template for Proof of Work protocols, such that if followed, can guarantee similar security assurances as to the Proof of Work present in Bitcoin. Secondarily, we also develop “useful” prototypes based on this template.

articleTitle: Book Reader using Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Different types of technical readers have been experimented precisely for people with poor vision, but at present no designed project can identify text from challenging patterns and backgrounds found on many commercial products. In this fast paced life, many people who love reading are unable to do so due to the time constraints. Hence, with our project we also aim to help them by making it easier to read using a turning mechanism with Raspberry Pi as the main component and no type of interface.

articleTitle: Utilizing Sparse Recovery Strategy to Optimize the Number of Sensing Elements for Fingerprint Scanning System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Various facilities and smart devices require highly secured authentication to access them. One of the widely used authentication methods is fingerprint verification. A fingerprint is an impression originated from friction ridges which are the raised narrow portion of the skin of the human finger. This paper presents a novel design and analysis for fingerprint data processing to optimize the number of sensing elements used in the sensors array-based scanner from a data recording and transmission point of view. This involves data modeling by representing them in the sparse domain and recovered later whenever they are required. The proposed approach has been tested using two sparse recovery algorithms. These are Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) and Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)-based compressed sensing algorithms. Our result shows that OMP based works better than the DCT-based one in terms of active sensing elements.

articleTitle: Real time Aho-Corasick Implementation of String Matching technique suitable for smart IOT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With growing technology, high speed internet, ease of access of hand held devices at affordable cost and many more such reasons, data is growing exponentially. Almost all application require cost effective, fast and efficient real time search, modify and replace feature within large volume of raw data, which is nothing but streams of characters. In this article we will propose a model for “Real time Aho-Corasick Implementation of String Matching (RACISM)” technique suitable for low cost internet enabled smart IOT device as an extension to virtual wireless sensor network (vWSN). AhoCorasick (AC) is one of the best multiple string matching algorithm also suitable for IOT application. AC is having linear running time complexity of O(n), where “n” is length of input stream. The beauty of this algorithm is that, once the AC automaton is ready then computation time doesn’t depend on the size of test data set, dictionary or pattern. It can match the pattern on the fly within continuous stream of data. The downside of Aho-Corasick algorithm is that it requires more memory to store AC automata as a TRIE data structure, which is an extension of deterministic finite automata (DFA). The focus of this paper is to propose lightweight TRIE based implementation of AC algorithm suitable for IOT devices.

articleTitle: Optimization of Braking-Torque in Anti-lock Braking System using Perturb & Observe Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This work presents a study on the application of Perturb & Observe Algorithm to determine the optimum braking force to be applied at the wheels of a vehicle so as to prevent the loss of traction. The objective of the study is to model the tire-road interaction of a vehicle using one-wheel model. The optimum braking force is obtained by subjecting the model to small perturbations in braking force. The slip and coefficient of friction is monitored to determine the tendency of the vehicle to enter into a skid due to a wheel-lock through simulation. The dynamic behavior of the tire-road system is also investigated under variable road conditions at the wheels through simulation. The peak braking torque is then obtained from the simulation results. The competency of an open-loop system to control a complex ABS application is demonstrated.

articleTitle: ECG Report Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: An electrocardiogram(ECG) is a test that determines the heart’s rhythm and electrical activities. Heart rhythm problems (arrhythmias) occur when the electrical impulses that coordinate your heartbeats don't work properly. To detect such anomalies a medical diagnosis by a specialist is required. The objective of the study is to generate a prediction on a captured image of an ECG graph using ANN and Image Processing to predict the anomaly from the report. Hence, This model will allow users to generate an analysis of their report for cardiac arrhythmias. There have been thorough studies on this topic using Neural Networks, we have tried to enhance the ANN on the MIT-BIH database with suitable algorithms and augmenting Image Processing. Thereby, the ANN model achieved an accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: Automated Generated Binaural Beats Using EEG: A User-Friendly Auditory Brain-Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A person who is physically, mentally, and socially fit is known as a healthy person. However, only 45% of people pass the criteria of being healthy. Approximately 25% of people in India are suffering from mental disorders and are mentally unfit. The current scenario and the lockdowns have increased the rates from 17.5% in March 2020 to 25% in March 2021. Stress has always been an integral part of human life. But with the rising age of digitisation, stress coping abilities are deteriorating, and mental health issues are increasing worldwide, especially among young adults. Mental health has become a significant concern, which needs to be dealt with as soon as possible. According to a survey, many deaths during the covid resulted from anxiety, panic, and mental weakness.
