Technology is proliferating, but problems like Mental health and cure are still technologically handicapped. Music is known for its healing beauty. It has profound psychophysical effects and can act as a great stress reliever. Integrating music and technology in the right manner can enhance psychological and physical health, which in turn increases brain plasticity. This paper proposes a device that uses non-invasive neurotechnology in acquiring any mental state, from heightened alertness to deep rest. The device uses auditory brain stimulation and neurofeedback technology in achieving so.Binaural Beat possesses brainwave entrainment properties, making it an excellent stimulus in designing this Auditory Brain-Computer Interface. The salient feature of this device is the usage of real-time EEG neurofeedback in producing a personalised binaural beat track for the user. The binaural beat track is structured to help the user smoothly achieve a particular mental state, providing a pleasant experience. Not only that, the experience becomes more harmonious with the integration of the Fibonacci and the Golden Ratio. The device escalates the benefits of binaural beats as the real-time EEG feedback reduces the occurrence of dizziness caused by the beats. Hence, creating an effective system to improve the cognitive functioning of the user.

articleTitle: An Efficient Parallel Implementation of Whale Colony Optimization Algorithm on GPU
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Whale colony optimization is a Swarm Intelligence (SI) Optimization algorithms derived from the hunting behavior of Humpback whales. The algorithm like other SI algorithms suffers from scaling problem when applied to large population. The problem can be overcome by efficiently distributing computationally expensive task on GPU and serial implementations on CPU. The paper proposes an efficient implementation of WCO on GPU/distributed platforms. The paper explores different strategies or parallel implementation on GPU and task balancing between CPU and GPU. The speed up/ other parameters are compared on standard dataset and result obtained provide a significant speed up compared to serial implementation on CPU

articleTitle: Fake Tweet Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Nowadays, online social media plays a vital role in real-world applications with potentially positive and negative effects. When some event has occurred, many of us discuss it online through social networking. Once sudden events happen there’s conjointly faux news that’s broadcasted that makes confusion because of the character of the events. A replacement and possible direction is confirming tweets at the side of media contents mistreatment data processing techniques. The planned framework consists of 2 major components: classifiers and neural networks. A classifier is responsible for classifying the tweet content and constructing a feature set whereas the neural network is to provide previous tweet credibility predictions stored in the memory.

articleTitle: Retinal Vascular Network Segmentation using a concatenated CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Retinal Vascular Network Extraction provides valid biomarkers for ocular related diseases, systemic disorders, and major health risk factors. Segmentation of retinal vessels needs careful extraction of each pixel on the vessel against low contrast, complex and compound features on the fundus images. Existing deep learning frameworks have been successful at segmenting vessels against the background with high accuracy. But these approaches, segmented ambiguous vessels also into the background hence some of the vessel calibre biomarkers: tortuosity, length to diameter ratio, branching angles, fractal dimensions, and vessel wall thickness were incorrectly estimated. Hence, we presented a concatenated deep learning CNN architecture that uses both UNet and ResNet with long and short skip connections to overcome the aforementioned issue. Furthermore, because it is made up of structured dropout convolutional blocks and trained with dynamic weights, the network maintained good accuracy and F measure in segmenting the blood vessels. The experimentation was carried out on the datasets: STARE, CHASE and DRIVE.

articleTitle: A Compact Slotted Ellipse Ultra-Wideband Antenna (UWB) for Detection Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents a compact slotted ellipse shape antenna for Ultra-Wideband (UWB) applications is suggested. The study of Bistatic UWB antenna design for detection applications is investigated. The overall antenna size is very small ${\mathrm {23 mm \times 24 mm \times 1.6 mm3}}$. The proposed UWB antenna has been design on FR4 material with $\varepsilon \mathrm{r}=4.4$ with h=1.6mm. The proposed UWB antenna offers good ultra-bandwidth from 2.7 GHz to 11.3 GHz corresponds to 127.15 % impedance bandwidth at VSWR 2:1. This UWB characteristics of antenna has been archived using partial tapered ground concept. The simulated radiation pattern of presented antenna is nearly omnidirectional in azimuth plane and Figure of 8 shape in elevation plane. The simulated and measured results observed good matching except some slight variation. The suggested UWB antenna is suitable for UWB communication systems.

articleTitle: Non-Iterative and Fast In-Vivo Gradient Shimming for Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging techniques such as spectroscopic and echo-planar imaging require a highly uniform main magnetic field, B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> for achieving acceptable diagnostic image quality. In this work a patient-specific, non-iterating and fast gradient shimming method for applying field correction in the imaging plane is described. It requires two gradient-echo images acquired at readout time difference which is a multiple of the fat-water separation frequency of the scanner for 1H protons. A simple phase unwrapping method is applied on the computed B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> field map to correct for the inherent modulo $2\pi$ phase wrappings. The three linear terms in the orthogonal basis function expansion of the field map are used for estimating the linear shim. Field correction terms are estimated via a magnitude image weighted least squares method. The technique is suitable for linear field shimming of diametric spherical volume centered at the magnet isocenter and could be incorporated into scanners that do not have shimming system.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra Low Noise High Precision Bandgap Voltage Reference
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents a design of ultra-low noise high-precision Bandgap Voltage Reference. The proposed BGR circuit is constructed from one PTAT source and one CTAT source. PTAT source is constructed from two diode-connected MOSFETs while CTAT is obtained from BJT. The summation of these reference voltages is proposed to achieve reference voltage independent of temperature. A two-stage high gain Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) is used to add and adjust slopes of PTAT and CTAT sources. Further Voltage to Current converter is added to get the required reference voltage by adjusting the value of the resistor through which current is passed. The proposed BGR circuit is implemented in standard CMOS 180nm technology and analyzed thoroughly using the Ngspice simulator. The proposed BGR circuit provides a temperature coefficient of 7.596ppm$/^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ at a reference voltage of 1.001V over the temperature range of $- 40^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ to +$125^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ with a supply voltage of 3.3V.

articleTitle: The Channel as a Traffic Acoustic and Inertial Sensors: Transport Vehicle Finding and Distribution based on CSI
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Vision based for the most part TSP is one among a few quick arising regions inside the canny establishment. This field of analysis has been actively studied over the past decade. TSP involves 3 phases: detection, recognition and trailing of assorted objects of interest. Since recognition and trailing typically place confidence in the results from detection, the power to observe objects of interest adequately assumes an essential part in TSP.

articleTitle: Birefringence Analysis of Octagonal Photonic Crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This article provides theoretical explanation of birefringence variation due to change in structure of core lattice of Photonic crystal fiber. Solid core, Hollow core, elliptical and rectangular single core versus tri-core analysis is performed in this work. Based on the results, higher birefringence is noticed in elliptical core structure.

articleTitle: A Novel Geo Tagging Based Biometric System for Granting Access to the User
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Biometrics, which refers to the analysis of biological data, is becoming increasingly important in today’s technological world. Biometrics is a technology of analyzing individual people based on physiological, behavioral, or morphological characteristics such as the face, fingerprint, iris, retina, voice, Geotags and signature, among others. Biometric techniques can be used to verify an individual’s identity. Biometrics is now widely used. Biometrics is now successfully used in a variety of fields such as forensic science, security, identification, and authorization systems. A lot of research has been done over the last three decades to advance biometric systems based on fingerprints, voice, iris, face, Geo tags and so on, but new biometrics have recently emerged. This paper provides an overview of various biometric systems, their applications, limitations, and the various types of access mechanisms that to be provides to the user. In this work we have designed a novel Geographical location based biometric authentication & access system to the user. We conclude the work by evaluate the performance of the proposed system based on Energy efficiency and latency.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Modified and Updated Modified Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Multilevel inverters(MLI) are being widely used these days as they are capable enough to increase the delivery of power and voltage to the load. This paper presents Modified MLI with cascaded H-Bridge and it is well suited for solar applications. A new model of MLI by upgrading the Modified CHB with reduced number of switches is proposed. The proposed MLI is implemented for 5-level and 9-level with level shifted PWM technique implementing carrier with In-phase disposition is used. The circuits are modeled and simulated with the help of Matlab/Simulink environment and its performance is compared with existing topologies.

articleTitle: Locating Restrooms for Specially-Abled People using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The overall purpose of the research is to locate restrooms and keep hygiene in consideration for those who are specially-abled. The app will be designed with the assistance of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, providing navigation, every step of the way which will be susceptible to use and comprehend. People with having disabilities implies that having fundamental difficulty accomplishing aspects. They are of numerous types like physical disability in nature, due to amputation inability to walk, sensory like blindness, hearing impairment with the assistance of this app, this gap can be filled. The problems faced by specially abled people have been taken into consideration creating a balanced platform for them. Utilizing the necessary tools and functions required for enabling them to locate and understand where the restrooms are, keeping in mind hygiene and safety factors. Certain parameters are taken into consideration such as voice recognition, Maps Live feature, magnifier, sign language interpretation, hands-free settings, and many more features. They could converse or speak and reach their destination with the support of the virtual assistant of a very specialized navigation system designed especially for them with a simple user interface which is easy to interpret and work efficiently according to the needs of the user.

articleTitle: Intellectual Property for DWT based Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In Recent times, the requirement of high quality images and application of advanced image processing techniques in medical and remote sensing fields has radically increased. Therefore, there is an increase in the data storage requirements to accommodate these high quality images. With image fusion techniques, the data stored in two images is fused into a single image while retaining the necessary information from both the source images, thus reducing the data storage. Implementation of image fusion technique requires a huge amount of computation, for which a dedicated hardware can be designed. To make further enhancements to the image fusion algorithms, Field Programmable Gate Array(FPGA) is a suitable target as it supports reconfigurable computing. Simulation is done using Xilinx System Generator 2019.1 software where the implementation utilizes Zedboard Zynq-7000XC 7Z 020-CLG 484-1 device. The fused image outputs are assessed using well-known image quality metrics like Structural Similarity Index(SSIM), Entropy etc.

articleTitle: Novel Approach for Classification of Fingerprints using Few-shot Classifier
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Fingerprint as a unique feature which benefit us to identify individual uniquely. Also, due to its various features fingerprint used in various research like human personality, criminal investigation, and various lifestyle-based diseases. Fingerprint having three basic patterns such as loops, whorls, and arches but in the loops of fingerprints were classified as left or right and the arches as tended arches by previous studies. In previous research various methods are used to identify or classify different fingerprint patterns. Based on this study, fingerprint patterns were categorized into five types, and a more accurate and efficient recognition process was developed to facilitate the human science research that will draw on fingerprint data. Based on this idea, a five different categories Manual annotation of fingerprint databases, and a Few-shot supervised learning algorithm as Few-shot Classifier Generative Adversarial Network is proposed for identifying real fingerprint patterns. Compared with previous method used for fingerprint classification, the proposed method classification as a result, a more accurate and effective classification can be generated for each type of finger in a novel scenario. With a fingerprint patterns database consisting of five categories, the model achieved an accuracy of 92.34%. The NIST-4 fingerprint dataset is used to test the proposed Fewshot GAN. Based on experimental results, the model can extract fingerprint pattern features from minimum samples of fingerprint databases and achieve greater accuracy and performance than previous models that relied on automatic input and feature extraction.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Control System In the Presence of Non-Linearity and Output Quantization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Event-triggered control is used for reduction in communication over the feedback link without compromising the stability of the system. This method of control achieves reduction of the communication overhead, by exchanging feedback information only when a certain threshold event condition has been met. The non-linearity due to integrator windup, causes performance degradation and can lead to an unstable system. Therefore, in this paper we study an event triggered control system with continuous input along with saturation non-linearity and dead-zone non-linearity. The results with various input signals demonstrate that event triggered system achieves desired performance in the presence of non-linearities and output quantization. Stable operation at large values of quantization steps demonstrates that the desired system performance can also be achieved with fewer bits.

articleTitle: Modern Technology for Evolving Mass Public Transportation in Cities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Buses and Rapid transit are an integral part of the mass transit system, especially in big cities & have become a lifeline for many people. It has made commuting much easier and faster. With the increase in population, there has been a massive surge in the number of passengers leading to crowding at platforms and bus stops. Since the frequency of buses and rapid transit is uneven and lacks proper real-time tracking of buses, we see a vast discrepancy in the number of passengers traveling. Such discrepancies not only have a vast economic impact but also make travelling by buses difficult for regular commuters, also increasing the travelling time. Especially considering the COVID 19 situation, it can cause a lot of problems. Thus, there is a need for a system that can adjust itself according to the number of passengers and real-time tracking of public transportation systems available for passengers.With this paper, we aim towards providing an intelligent transportation system using real-time data to manage the frequency of mass transit systems by crowdsourcing people on bus stands in real-time using CCTV, analyzing the data, and making decisions realtime on the frequency of these mass transit systems by analyzing data through the help of data science and machine learning which would help in automation of rapid transit systems.

articleTitle: VLSI implementation of Digital Watermarking Technique for security and authentication of Digital Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Nowadays it’s very easy to tamper with any image and make it available to whole world. As digital image manipulation software are at readily accessible on each and every desktop. Ensuring digital image integrity and image owner safety has become a major issue. This is probably better solution (digital watermarking technique) which is available for this issue to prevent and protect from tampering of image and objects. As an advance to the existing various methods of digital watermarking techniques. In this approach ato watermark the image in the digital camera we can integrate the watermarking chip within framework, to demonstrate that this chip can embedded the watermark directly at the stage of capturing process itself which acts as a real time insertion and reduces the time consuming process of externally adding the watermark to the original image or video after capturing it. Illegal recovering and transmission of multimedia data can be protected via watermark or digital signature or copyright label that authenticates the data. This approach extended the opportunity of protecting the content after the release of content to the open environment.

articleTitle: Rayleigh wave Propagation using rotation, initial stress & two-temperature on generalized micropolar thermoelastic medium in context of DPL with Impedance Boundary conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this present work, we consider the governing equations of Rayleigh wave with rotation, and two-temperature in the context of DPL with impedance boundary conditions in generalized micropolar thermoelastic half-space. We solved the governing equation by using surface wave techniques and satisfying the suitable radiation conditions and obtained the frequency equation. Impact of rotation, two-temperature, initial stress with IBC are computed numerically. The impact of various parameters against dimensionless speed have been shown graphically.

articleTitle: Powering Prediction of an Autonomous Campus Shuttle using CFD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Universities and colleges worldwide are being equipped with campus shuttles due to their large campus size. These generally are 6-to-8-seater vehicles to transport students around the campus. Academic spaces around the world are built as safe places for the academia of the institution. Due to high safety advantages, many universities are considering utilizing autonomous vehicles instead of manual driving. These autonomous vehicles require various LiDAR, Radar, ultrasonic sensors, and cameras to sense their surroundings. These sensors need to be placed externally due to a larger area to detect any incoming dangers. These sensors, due to their placement, may impact the airflow around the vehicle. The present paper discusses the change in flow characteristics of the vehicle, such as pressure, velocity, drag coefficient, and lift coefficient. The vehicle’s drag coefficient is expected to reduce by 2.2%, and the lift coefficient is likely to decline by 23.7% compared to the case without the sensors.

articleTitle: Teaching Aid For Program Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Optimization is essential to obtain the “best” design against a set of priority criteria or constraints. However, optimization techniques need not be intuitive for all those who venture into software development, thus impeding the learning of certain programming concepts. A teaching aid for program optimization can be helpful in the field of performance engineering education. In this paper, we present our automated tool for C source code optimization. The input provided to the tool is a C program that is resource-intensive. On the input source, the tool performs optimizations in various directives and generates an equivalent C program. The tool presents the correctness of the processed program by showing the outputs of both the input and optimized programs, after running them in the backend. The tool also compares the difference in performance between the two programs by providing performance metrics. The tool can potentially assist in the learning of general program optimization techniques as well as the concepts of compiler design and performance engineering. The optimizations implemented in the tool go beyond data structure and algorithmic optimizations, focusing on various techniques that can be implemented at high-level structures of the source, most of which aren’t done in popular compilers. Automation of such procedures could conveniently provide an insight into fine programming paradigms and help the learner grasp abstract concepts.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Segmentation and Detection using Cuckoo Search Evolutionary Algorithms in Early Stage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In all around the world the main reason of death among people is the lung cancer. If the detection of lung cancer is done at the initial stage it can increase the probabilities of survival in humans. If this disease is detected on time, the complete 5-year rate of survival of patients injured with lung cancer from 14% to 49%. The detection approach of lung cancer that uses image processing is utilized in this research for classification in the presence of lung cancer as a CT scan. The designed model used some steps like pre-processing, image segmentation, and feature extraction along with classification. For segmentation K-means along with Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA) is used. Feature extraction technique is utilized for extraction purpose of features from lung Region of Interest (ROI) data by using Maximally Stable Extrenal Regions (MSER) and these features are used to train Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is used for testing later. At the end to see the type of lung cancer diseases are present by using classification technique of neural network named as Convolutional Neural Network. The work has been executed in MATLAB software and performance has been assessed in terms of True Positive Rate (TPR), True Negative Rate (TNR), False Positive Rate (FPR), False Negative Rate (FNR), Classification Accuracy, Error, and Execution Time.

articleTitle: Ensemble Model-Based Prediction for River Management: A Case Study on River Kaveri and Coastal Karnataka
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Floods are a major threat in India. More over 40 million hectares (mha) of the total geographical area of 329 million hectares (mha) are flood-prone. Floods are a common occurrence that result in a large number of deaths and extensive damage to livelihood systems, property, infrastructure, and public utilities. The fact that flood-related damages are on the rise is reason for concern. Flood forecasting systems that integrate flood forecasting followed by warning are now functioning in many areas so that early warnings can prevent damages and save life. To mimic the complex data of physical activity of floods, machine learning (ML) methods contributed highly in the development of forecast systems providing cost-effective solutions. The use of machine learning techniques is gaining increasing popularity. In this work, the performance of machine learning algorithms by applying it to a long-term time-series data of flood runoff, daily runoff and weekly runoff of the river Kaveri is compared. We have come up with predicting the daily-runoff, weekly runoff, flood runoff and discharge individually of Kaveri dataset using Facebook prophet and the use of Logistic Regression Model for flood classification. The performance of multiples techniques is compared using performance metrics like root mean squared error (RMSE).

articleTitle: A Novel Encoder Architecture for 8-bit Flash ADC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents design and implementation of novel encoder architecture for low power 8-bit flash ADC. The proposed encoder architecture uses AND-XOR steering logic which is accompanied by the NOR based ROM array. The NOR based ROM array converts 256-bit thermometer code into 8-bit binary code. The proposed encoder circuit requires less hardware as compared to the reported encoders and therefore works at higher frequency and consumes less power and area. The proposed encoder is implemented successfully in 180nm technology and verified using pre-layout and post-layout simulation results

articleTitle: Active Cell Balancing Using Individual Cell Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In recent days electrical vehicles are gaining wide importance in the locomotive and automobile sector and essentially replacing the conventional IC engine. Electrical vehicles are usually powered by battery pack of several cells fashioned in a particular series-parallel configuration. For efficient utilization of energy in terms of charge from battery it requires a design of battery management system that can monitor and control certain functions like under voltage, over voltage, cell balancing. Cell balancing is a technique of equalizing every cells State of Charge (SoC) to extract optimal energy from battery and eliminates the uncertainty caused by cell unbalancing. Therefore, this paper proposes cell balancing technique using Individual Cell Equalizer (ICE). The method described uses buck-boost converter to transfer the charge from the cell with higher SoC to a cell with lower SoC. The cell balancing phenomenon is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink ® platform.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based X73 Ubiquitous Mobile Healthcare System: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Improving QoS in internet of things (IoT) networks is a multi-faceted challenge. It involves designing security algorithms that should work effectively on a battery powered device. This effectiveness must be in terms of low delay requirement, low energy requirement, high throughput requirement and high packet delivery ratio requirement. All these requirements are very difficult to achieve due to the fact that the number of attacks prevalent to any IoT network hare very large in number, and each attack has its own signature type. For instance, DDoS attacks target a particular node from different attack points, while sybil attacks modify the data packets such that the actual receiver doesn’t receive the packet; there are many such attacks prevalent to IoT networks. This paper proposes a machine learning powered algorithm that uses Genetic Algorithm, to route data with high QoS in IoT networks. The main advantage of using a Genetic Algorithm(GA) is the flexibility of route design, which can be changed as per the X73 IoT application. This text compares the proposed GA powered network results with a nonGA implementation on electronic healthcare record (EHR) application; and the network efficiency showed more than 20% improvement in terms of delay, and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Multiagent based Information Validation Scheme in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: IoT (Internet of Things) and its diverse applications domains are transforming the lives of individuals significantly, offering intelligent services that will eventually constitute integral part of living environment. The IoT services work depending on the data flows gathered from the various actuators and sensors. The accuracy and security of sensor data transmitted over the IoT system is a critical factor in ensuring the proper functioning of IoT services. Therefore validation of data gathered in distributed IoT network is an increasingly relevant issue. Even though validation can be provided by the immediate solution of installing redundant identical systems, real-world alteration constraints can often make this difficult or even stop it. So here in this paper we have proposed an intelligent validation scheme that uses multiagents. We have evaluated the performance and effectiveness of proposed scheme for varying number of nodes and sensing range.

articleTitle: Detection Of Chest Catheters Using Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the rise of deep learning and its limitless possibilities to solve the problems at hand as par to humans the researchers have been continually making efforts to apply the deep learning techniques in the medical field as well. Biomedical Image Segmentation has been one such field where it has performed exceptionally well because of the consistent efforts of the researchers across the computer vision community. In this paper we aim to address the problem of chest catheter detection using the well known Mask-RCNN benchmark architecture. While addressing the problem of chest catheter detection we focus on having a better recall for our model rather than focusing purely on accuracy.

articleTitle: Various Threats and Challenges to Information Security via Active and Passive Attack
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cloud computing have many advantages such as ease of accessibility, scalability, cost savings, storage immortality and disaster recovery etc. However, it is highly vulnerable to attacks and compromises security and privacy of data. The attacks are broadly classified as active and passive attack. The existing methods focus on specific type of attack. Various existing methods of attack detection and prevention are reviewed in this paper and a comprehensive mechanism to prevent these attacks is proposed.

articleTitle: An Improved Technique for Diabeties Prediction By Combining Feature Selection Techniques And BFGS Optimization Algorithm With Weight Constrained Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Diabetes is among basic illnesses and bunches of individuals are experiencing this infection. Age, weight, absence of activity, genetic diabetes, living style, awful eating routine, hypertension, and so forth can cause Diabetes. Individuals having diabetes have high danger of sicknesses like coronary illness, kidney infection, stroke, eye issue, nerve harm, and so forth. Current practice in medical clinic is to gather required data for diabetes determination through different tests and suitable therapy is given dependent on conclusion. Information science techniques can possibly profit other logical fields by revealing new insight into regular enquiries. Both engineered and true investigations show that ANN strategy is best, more dependable and seriously powerful with respect to differed bunch sizes, shapes and densities. However, in the event that a portion of the loads have huge qualities, they overwhelm and in some cases decide the neural organization's yield; thusly, corrupting the grouping proficiency of the organization along these lines current work is centered around the execution of a Weight Constrained Neural Network Training Algorithm for productive forecast of diabetes utilizing Limited-memory BFGS (L-BFGS or LMBFGS) as an advancement calculation. The strategy is exceptionally proficient when weight esteems are enormous and has been appeared to adequately make forecast if diabetes.

articleTitle: Code-Viz: Data Structure Specific Visualization and Animation Tool For User-Provided Code
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Data structures are used by programmers to help in the arrangement of data for a particular purpose. The use of the right data structure improves the performance of algorithms and increases time and space efficiency.Data structures involve the usage of pointers and references for representing user’s data. It is very difficult for new users/learners to see how these pointers and references change. It is also very difficult to find a correlation between the program being executed and the data structure being used in the code.Immersive understanding and involved learning are enabled by visualisation of these data structures. As a result, the user can appreciate the way the pointers and references are used in data structures.The aim of Code-Viz is to provide data structure specific visualisations and animations that are both intuitive and accurate. The tool is language agnostic, supporting major programming languages (currently C and Python). Code-Viz is implemented as a browser-based tool with a code editor where users can visualize code without the need to install any software, thus facilitating ease of access.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vehicle Following techniques in Electric Vehicles using Cyber Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems are helping to revolutionize the way the existing technologies and applications are working, with the help of its sensors and actuation devices. Clubbing CPS with vehicular networking has helped to impart good decision making capabilities, reducing the chances of collision and improvise the flow of traffic on roads. With Vehicular Cyber Physical Systems intelligent interaction has been achieved between autonomous vehicles and road side equipments, which enable good management and flow of data by the traffic dynamics. Various techniques and protocols have been introduced for the incorporation of CPS into Intelligent Transportation systems, this paper highlights their way of working, discussion the shortfalls of the techniques and putting forward the best method for utilizing CPS to its full capability in vehicular networks.

articleTitle: Application of the Fiber Optic Network in Underground Protection Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This article describes the application of a communication network using optical fiber in underground protection systems. This application aims to use optical fiber in order to remove electromagnetic and atmospheric interference in these systems, increase the data transmission capacity and maintain a low operational cost. This fiber optic network is developed with the ring communication topology, allowing the use of communication protocols such as DNP3 and those within the IEC 61850 standard (MMS and GOOSE). As a redundancy protocol, this network will use the REP (Resilient Ethernet Protocol) as an alternative to the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP). As protection systems, Underground Fault Tracking, Distribution Transformer Sensing, Self-healing and Logical Selectivity initiatives will be studied. The content presented in this article is part of the Urban Futurability research and development (R&D) project, from Enel Distribuição São Paulo. The project was carried out in the city of São Paulo, Brazil, in a region with a high-density load and about 20,000 consumer units of the residential and commercial type.

articleTitle: Testing of eSIM Profile Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Embedded Subscriber Identification Module (eSIM) is a SIM standard that allows re-programmability and remote activation. It gives end users the ability to switch between the operators without getting a new SIM card, that is, it reduces the mechanical effort required to change the SIM card as its directly embedded into the device. Profile Management is a feature of eSIM for Consumer Solution that allows end users to manage the profiles using the Local User Interface. Profile Management is carried out using ES10c interface and includes add profile, enable profile, disable profile, delete profile, set/edit nickname, and list profile. The main objective of this paper is to test the local profile management of eSIM. This is carried out by, first setting up a testing environment, developing scenarios and implementing the scenarios in test bench. The results obtained are then validated to see if the required functionality is met before making the product available to the entire world.

articleTitle: A Literature Review on Secured Data Management using Block Chain Technology in Healthcare Sector
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The block chain technology is one of the important revolutionary innovations as well as the enhancements of the Information Technology (IT) industry. The current technological enhancements permit for a main improvement in the healthcare sectors. The accessibility as well as the information security is the crucial considerations for the communication as well as the integration with the Electronic Healthcare Record (EHR) systems when the private medical information is shared. Therefore, this paper plans to provide an appropriate literature review on existing secured data management using the block chain technology in the health care sector. In the initial step, related works as well as the chronological review of the considered contributions are explained. Next, the different datasets used in the considered works, simulation platform, as well as the performance measures are also explained briefly. In the final step, several research challenges is defined on the basis of advanced techniques that considered the unresolved challenges with respect to the secured data management using the block chain technology in the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Grayscale Image Authentication with Data Repair Capability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The technique of image authentication has become increasingly popular in recent years. The digital revolution in image processing has made it feasible to quickly and easily create, manipulate, and transport digital images. Therefore most of the vital photos such as military, Medical, Companies secret data must be protected against alteration. So to safeguard originality and validity of multimedia images and essential scanned documents many authentication methods are evolved. The usage of portable network graphics (PNG) images with bitplane slicing method in this study provides an image authentication scheme with data repair capability. Experiments indicate that the authentication system can withstand and repair original data in the face of various attacks. It also demonstrates the work’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Survey on Segmentation & Clustering techniquesto detect brain tumor for MRI
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: MRI brain image segmentation is a primary task in medical image processing because it allows the brain’s anatomy to be understood with greater clarity. Medical Imaging is most concerned with the efficient and accurate acquisition of information, with the smallest amount of error possible. MRI is the most reliable and safe of all medical imaging processes. This is safe, and it does not involve the body being exposed to harmful radiation. Because of this MRI, the tumor can be segmented, and the MRI can be carried out. The use of several different techniques is included in tumor segmentation. Over the past several decades, multiple segmentation methods have been published. This paper covers several alternative traditional and new tumor segmentation and detection techniques. In order to conduct this research study, we will be reviewing other professionals’ research and compiling it into one paper.

articleTitle: Effect of Vehicle Characteristics on Quality of Perishable Foods in Cold Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: India is one of the world’s leading producers of perishable goods. As a result, maintaining the quality of these products until the final stage of the cold chain is essential. Generally, cold reefers are preferred for the transportation of various perishable products. Temperature and humidity fluctuations in cold reefers are responsible for the deterioration of perishable food quality. It is vital to maintain food quality during the cold chain transportation stage, where vehicle features also play a role in reducing food loss. The current study proposes a model to link vehicle attributes to relative humidity, and analytics to improve food quality at every stage of the cold chain using machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis of MISO Converter with Intelligent Control for Solar Water Pumping
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this study, a multiple-input, single-output (MISO) CUK configuration has been presented for solar powered water pumping system. DC-DC converter contributes to the system’s efficiency by assisting in the tracking of maximum power point in conjunction with the MPPT technique. The MISO-CUK converter topology enables a smooth and efficient operation of the system even under fluctuating atmospheric conditions. The MISO-CUK configuration brings about a reduction in the output voltage ripple to a great extent when compared with a conventional single CUK employed to the solar fed water pumping system. The maximum power point is tracked using an intelligent control approach based on an artificial neural network (ANN). Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) are observed to be more reliant, quick and efficient in cases of dynamic weather conditions. The performance of CUK-MISO DC-DC converter topology implemented along with ANN based MPPT technique for the application of solar fed water pumping is verified in MATLAB/Simulink tool. The suggested system structure portrays a good efficiency and reliable response to the changing irradiation conditions.

Author Keywords: SPV Water Pumping System Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT)

articleTitle: Implementation of Rapidchain on BaaS to improve Blockchain efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The challenge of scalability faced in blockchain has acquired huge traction recently. Even though there are several ways possible to estimate scalability of a blockchain network such as number of channels or number of peers or the consensus protocol etc. In this paper, ‘number of transactions’ has been used as the factor to measure scalability. In the context of the aforementioned introduction, ‘Sharding’ is one of the techniques which has capability to increase multifold transactions which can be processed and thus holds promising potential to enhance scalability of the blockchain network. Sharding technique basically sub-groups the overall network of blockchain in to different components called as committees or shards where each shard or the committee works on different batches of the transactions. The intention of this paper is to elucidate a way of implementing Rapidchain protocol to maximise resiliency for securing shards along with increase in number of transactions. The aforementioned optimization will have result of increasing the efficiency of the blockchain and at the same shall preserve the characteristic of decentralization also. In addition to enhancing scalability and transaction rate, optimising energy consumption for transactions validation by using Hyperledger integration with BaaS void of ‘mining’, are also the major focus points of this paper.

articleTitle: Application of Mini-Max Method for Trajectory Planning of PUMA-560 using Cubic B Spline Interpolation Technique for Jerk Minimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In today’s generation where automation of processes in manufacturing industries is ever rising, robots and robot manipulators have an important role to play in performing a wide range of operations from assembly to pick and place, which makes improvement of their performance a paramount importance. High jerks in robot manipulators result in reduced performance. In this paper, a technique is proposed to attain an ideal trajectory of a six degrees of freedom industrial robot known as PUMA560 with minimum jerk. This is achieved by right trajectory planning where it functions under a fixed obstacle with minimum jerk. The jerk values depend on the orientation of end effectors and intermediate points that are determined based on the fixed obstacle. Cubic B-Spline is used to generate a smooth path and minimax method is used for jerk value minimization.

articleTitle: Defocus Blurs Analysis in Images Using Single Parameter Key Point Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Photographs are a beautiful way to store our memories. Although high resolution cameras are now available, image blurriness still persists to be a hurdle in various computer vision applications. So it is important to analyse the different types of blurs. Defocus blur is mainly considered here. The interest points of images are detected and matching of key point is done for match metric valuation and for visual analysis to detect the extend of deviation of interest points from the input image. This gives an idea of the information lost in images. A histogram match metric using chi-square estimation is evaluated. Also as an application, key point detection in image compression is done and match metric is computed.

articleTitle: Data In-Transit Security and Mitigation Mechanism in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cloud computing presents extended model for IT administrations and conveyance and it generally includes over-a-network, on-request, self-administrated access, which is powerfully versatile and flexible, using pools of regularly virtualized assets. Through these highlights, distributed computing can possibly further develop the manner in which organizations and IT work by offering quick beginning up, adaptability, versatility and cost productivity. Despite the fact that distributed computing gives convincing advantages and financially savvy alternatives for IT facilitating and development, new dangers and openings for security misuses are presented. Security principles, arrangements and controls are subsequently of the embodiment to help the executives in ensuring and defending frameworks and information. Cloud computing dangers ought to be dissected and perceived to have the option to secure conditions and stay away from information being uncovered. This work dissects current and future patterns on distributed computing and relief for distributed computing security hazards as a key advance towards guaranteeing secure distributed computing conditions. It is of embodiment to comprehend the abilities and dangers of cloud computing before a choice is made to move to a cloud computing provider.

articleTitle: AR CARD: Interactive Cards using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Interactive cards using augmented reality are used to break the bounds of information confined within a small card. The existing business cards cannot give much information in a single glance. Only trivial information is present in the business card which only gives vague information. Augmented Reality can enhance the user experience by including much more information regarding the user by just scanning the business card. AR CARD allows the user to view the details or information that are not present on the business card as an augmented detail view by including more interactive UI thereby enhancing the user experience. The augmented display for a specific card can only be triggered by a target image which when scanned, details related to the target image which is the business card is fetched and augmented. By implementing an Interactive Augmented card the user can have a better interactive experience as well as acquire a lot of information which a business card is unable to provide.

articleTitle: Effective Crop Prediction Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: India is an imperial nation of over a billion people, a glorious country with a conspicuous culture. India is a worldwide agricultural powerhouse. Indian civilization grew up along with the agricultural system. Indian economical condition stability depends on agricultural wealth. Agriculture is the primitive profession in India, which is highly dependent on the new technology for obtaining large profits. Deep learning is the most emerging and exciting technology which can solve real world problems in an efficient way. The prime objectives of deep learning are to train a model using data or experience for solving real world problems. Prediction of suitable crops is useful to the farmers in the field of agriculture. Our research work proposes and implements a model to predict crop yield from previous data. The proposed model for crop prediction is developed using Feed forward neural network, Rectified Linear Activation Unit, backward and forward propagation techniques. The main chemical elements which are taken into the proposed model are nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, hydrogen along with rainfall and temperature. The experimental result shows the proposed model performance is quite satisfactory.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) from Brain MR Images Based on Feature Optimization and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurological disorder that begins in childhood and lasts the rest of person’s life. It has an influence on how a person communicates and learns, as well as how they act and connect with others. There are number of techniques that can be used to help the child to grow and acquire new abilities. Behavioral and communication therapy, skill training, and symptom-controlling medications are all options available for treatment which are time consuming and subjective. Therefore, early and accurate detection of ASD is required which will help in treatment planning. With the patient’s history and different medical tests, the brain MR scans can proceed towards the distinguish between the Typical controls (TC) and ASD controls. The work is towards the development of Computer Aided Diagnosis for ASD detection and its classification into Typical Control (TC) and ASD. This paper is about the selection of optimized features using Forward selection of features and PCA with machine learning techniques for accuracy improvement. The textural features are extracted using GLCM. The investigation used 529 autistic controls and 571 typical controls from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) for sMRI and fMRI. This model is considered for automatic classification between Typical Controls and ASD. The model gives maximum classification accuracy 66.66% for sMRI using Support Vector Machine classifier and 56.66% for fMRI using Decision Tree Classifier with PCA and 14 textural features.

articleTitle: Optimization of Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) Services for Development of Smart Electric Grid: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Consequent to the policies adopted by various nations to assimilate e-mobility, the times ahead will see large numbers of Electric Vehicle (EV) on the roads. Another important happening is the growing advent of smart grid. EVs being a crucial part of smart grid implementation, the last decade has promoted an extensive research in the field of integration of EVs with the electricity grid. The vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) approach sets a new trend for operation of distribution system by allowing the utility to improve system Power Quality by operating EVs in a controlled manner to provide grid support services, reduce peak demand and facilitates integration of renewable resources. The paper reviews the potential of V2G in Smart Grid development, explores various studies on grid-integration aspect of EVs, addresses upcoming issues in V2G development and also details optimization approaches for upgrading V2G services. It is envisioned that this paper will provide a helping hand for academics and industrialists in the development of V2G system.

articleTitle: Root Cause Analysis & Predictive Electro-Mechanical Interaction Analysis Algorithm Development for Minimizing Electric Arc Furnace Transformer Degradation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Commonly Electric Arc Furnaces are employed in steel mills for heating raw metal to its melting point using an electric arc, and to supply very high rated current usually in kA (kilo-Ampere) to this electric arc, specially designed transformers are being installed. This high current, electrode unbalanced positions result in fluctuating system load parameters, causing high stress on insulation, high current requirement, very unusual load patterns in the supplying transformer. Here I observing power quality problems in furnace steel plant by modeling visited steel mill system in MATLAB simulation. This paper shows how the position of the electrode will affect on steel mill transformer harmonics. Here, it is used for measuring the current, voltage profile, each harmonic and THD of an electric furnace in loading and unloading of scrap material.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection and Classification using Pretrained Inception-v3
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the major health issues faced by the population, with over 400 million people in the world suffering from the same. It is estimated that almost half the percentage out of these people are never diagnosed. Apart from the basic symptoms and effects caused by diabetes; retinopathy, or Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a harmful condition that can be a big threat to one’s eyesight. If left undiagnosed or untreated, this condition can cause permanent blindness. This makes it highly crucial to ensure quick consultation and proper treatment. However, it requires appropriate detection measures to be implemented. The need for automated DR diagnosis has been recognized lately due to the difficulty and time-consuming manual techniques used; and several image classification and detection methods are being tested in this field. This work utilizes a pretrained Inception-v3, a Deep Convolutional Neural Network for disease detection and classification. The best trained model is successful in achieving about 82% accuracy and a Cohen’s weighted Kappa score of 0.72.

articleTitle: Optical Disc Segmentation from Color Fundus Image using Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization and Morphological Operations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Various ocular diseases, like Cataract followed by Glaucoma and Diabetic Retinopathy, are the world’s leading causes of blindness and affect millions of people every year. Rapid and automated testing is therefore essential for assisting in early discernment and analysis. The traditional method of screening for such diseases involves manual analysis of the fundus image obtained by ophthalmologists whose versions of determining the region-of-interest vary. Segmenting the disc region serves as the first and crucial step before feature extraction, for the diagnosis of a variety of pathologies and abnormalities related to the retina. For automated analysis, various features, such as cup to disc ratio (CDR), area cup-disc ratio (ACDR) etc., are estimated to foretell the onset of such diseases. Our paper proposed and explored a new segmentation technique based on the Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) method and mathematical morphology for optic disc discernment. The analysis was done on a freely available database, DRISTI-GSI. The segmentation results of the proposed algorithm showed an average accuracy of 94.7% after testing and verification.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning based Rice Leaf Disease Classification with Inception-V3
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the agriculture field, the detection of diseases from various plants through images is one of the most vital areas that needs to be ameliorated. The collection of cultivating crops and alleviation of features are the source of plant infection. A range of spot evaluation methods and disease diagnoses have been applied and advanced in a broad variety of crops. The Deep Learning concept of artificial intelligence is applied. However, this article introduces a model to detect disease in less time. Image processing techniques are used for operating the data with various methods. Three distinct rice plant diseases are included in the dataset: brown spot, leaf smut, and bacterial leaf blight. Spotting the disease on plants has been performed with various techniques like transfer learning and image data generators. In transfer learning, there are four types of approaches used: reusing the trained model, pre-trained model, feature extraction, and popular trained models. A popular model used to train the data is InceptionV3. Categorical cross-entropy is used for calculating the loss and optimization of the model. A surpassing result of 99.33% accuracy has been achieved on the testing dataset.

articleTitle: Preserving Privacy in Clouds using Fully Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cloud computing designates a big architectural change on the way to thin clients and accessible central facility of computing resources. Clients are more interested to outsource their data on commercial public clouds for more flexibility and to reduce economic investments. In clouds, there is no direct control over resources by clients, so the security of data privacy is at the sake, provided by service providers. Traditional cryptography techniques cannot impose privacy necessitated by cloud computing services. Powerful recently apprehended, Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), a fully functional construct that can enable search over encrypted text. The Paper discussed different types of FHE schemes, including schemes based on integers and polynomial over the ring of integers. The paper also includes the basic steps needed to construct any FHE scheme. The schemes are explained, along with their pros and cons. The paper may contribute to the development of privacy-preserving schemes of Cloud Computing.

articleTitle: Steel Frame Structure Defect Detection Using Image Processing and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Steel Frame Structure Defect Detection is one of the main stages in constructing a building, where most of the time it has been done manually, which leads to no proper inspection. The aim of this paper is to detect six main defects in welded steel frame structure by using image processing and deep learning algorithms, where the application would aid individuals in construction sites to identify defects in said steel frame structures at an early stage of building in order to avoid casualties caused by the defect. An android application incorporated with a classification model was proposed and built. In this research, MobileNet has been used as the classifier algorithm, where Transfer Learning has been implemented on the pretrained model on ImageNet. CNN layers have been customized where GlobalAveragePooling2D layer has been implemented with Rectified Linear Unit being the activation layer and being fed into SoftMax layer. Furthermore, SGD optimizer with Categorical Cross Entropy Loss functionality have been applied. An image preprocessing of data augmentation and image transformation have been done. Viewpoint range is achieved at 10 – 3cm and error free under device rotation circumstances. Robustness and processing performance of the application have been achieved to an optimum level since it runs locally. The mean accuracy level of the device has been achieved for 91% for scratch, 78% for patches, 81% pitted surface, 78% for crazing, 73% for rolled in scale and 67% for inclusion defects in welded steel frame structure which sums up with a model mean accuracy being at 78%.

articleTitle: Retinal Vessel Detection Using Residual Y-net
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this Corona Pandemic, Diabetic patients are affected a lot. Unfortunately, due to the consumption of steroids, people are affected by mucormycosis, which is a kind of fungal infection, making this situation worse. Patients get swollen red eyes, and diabetic patients are more vulnerable to it, as they suffer from Diabetic Retinopathy. It has become essential to determine the damage caused to the eye to save patients from vision loss. Only doctors can identify how the condition of the eye by physical examination. But this is a tricky and time-consuming job. With the help of fundus photography and deep learning algorithms, the detection and classification process will speed up. There are many existing image detection algorithms, but they do not have efficient feature retention and lightweight architecture model. This paper proposes Residual Y-net architecture that works excellently on a balanced medium-size. With the help of segmented features, it acquires reliable features which help in classification. It is a very lightweight architecture inspired by U-net, Deep Residual U-net, and Y-net. The addition of residual units in the network has significantly improved the accuracy rate. It is observed that a balanced dataset gives a much accurate performance than an unbalanced dataset. The proposed model’s test accuracies on medium-size unbalanced and balanced datasets are 90.39% and 93.60%, respectively.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Solution for Obfuscation Detection and Removal Based on Comparative Analysis of Deobfuscation Tools
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Obfuscation is the technique of making code difficult to read or comprehend. Nowadays, attackers often hide their malicious code using obfuscation and use it as a tool to exploit users. In order to grasp the internal logic of the code and formulate countermeasures against malicious code (hidden by obfuscation), obfuscated code must be detected or eliminated (“deobfuscated”). The current technology is evolving in terms of securing software from obfuscated malware. This paper proposes a comprehensive solution to detect obfuscation using techniques like Taint Analysis, Symbolic Execution of Code, Construction of Control Flow Graph. Further, this study also includes a comprehensive comparative analysis of existing deobfuscation tools and gives a complete solution to tackle some of the most prevalent obfuscation techniques like Javascript, Packer and XOR Obfuscation.

articleTitle: Voice Based Emotion Detection using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: each activity suggestion is based on the induction of the seen feeling. These specifically influence the state of reality. In order to get emotional-related reaction from robots, computers and other cleverly machines, the primary and unequivocal step is precise emotion recognition. This extend presents the execution of this work with the profound learning method of Convolution Neural Systems (CNN). The design is an adaption of image processing CNN, modified in Python utilizing Keras model-level library and Tensor Flow backend. The foundation that lays the establishment of the classification of emotions based on voice parameters is briefly displayed. This can be based on the adjustment of the profound learning demonstrated for preparing the sound records, the training of the CNN with a set of recordings. The included extraction is done by utilizing the librosa library which changes over the sound records into the specified information i.e. MFCC (Mel Recurrence Cepstral Coefficients).Keras library is utilized for the numerical computations. LSTM with CNN is actualized within the handle to move forward the precision of the framework. The dataset used in this process in RAVDESS.

articleTitle: Enterprise Optimization in Pharmaceutical Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Enterprise optimization has become a major target in the pharmaceutical industry because of the increasing pressure for staying relevant in the worldwide commercial center. The ever-increasing competition, changing regulatory requirements, new emerging technologies along with a lot of other factors are pushing pharmaceutical manufacturers towards Enterprise optimization for the purpose of fast-tracking innovation to boost their productivity and product quality. The objectives of Enterprise optimization include profit maximization, asset utilization, management of inventory levels, and coordinated decision making. These business exercises are moderately troublesome because of the association of various risk factors. In this paper, applications that have relevance to Enterprise optimization have been reviewed, with special attention to innovative drug development life cycles which are prone to substantial risks. This paper proposes a decision-making methodology with the identification of uncertainties and risks based on the Fuzzy AHP approach.

Author Keywords: Decision Support System (DSS) and Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchical Process (FAHP)

articleTitle: Time-Triggered Frequency Scaling in Network-on-Chip for Safety-Relevant Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Networks on Chip (NoC) are used in Multiprocessor System on a Chip (MPSoC) architectures and safety-relevant systems as a communication backbone to cope with high communication traffic. Nevertheless, network interfaces and the routers within the NoC add to the power consumed by the chip. This paper presents models and algorithms for low power techniques in NoC based on dynamic frequency scaling for safety-relevant real-time systems. The novel technique is time-triggered frequency scaling to enable power and energy efficiency while preserving safety and real-time guarantees. Time-triggered Frequency Scaling (TTFS) is used in the routers where each router frequency is adjusted according to a schedule. Three techniques, namely global, cluster-based, and route-based TTFS are considered. Using the Orion 3 tool, we show that up to 59 % of the power consumed by an NoC can be saved when a route-based power saving technique is applied.

articleTitle: Hyperledger Based Private Blockchain Technology in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Industry for Preventing Substandard Drug Production
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The pharmaceutical drug, globally known as medicine, helps the entire population be cured and promoted to well-being. Besides population growth, the demands for drugs and the trafficking of unfit, substandard, and falsified medicines are growing faster. Substandard drugs are increasing terribly in undeveloped countries, mainly affecting low and middle-income people. Having a massive lack of general knowledge and cognitive skill, they buy the drugs from unqualified sellers and cannot detect falsified medicines sequentially. In reducing substandard drug manufacturing and solving the terrible upshots, the drug manufacturer can apply the smooth and elementary system of private blockchain technology at a nominal price, significantly contributing to digitizing the old-aged pharmaceutical industry. In this paper, we have utilized a Hyperledger based private and permissioned blockchain to generate and inspect reports from both Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) departments inside the drug manufacturing organizations. Analysis reports regarding the tests conducted on the drugs are stored in the assets of the blockchain. These assets produced by executing transactions become immutable in nature, thus preserving the transparency and accountability of the quality controlling management. Moreover, the use of chaincode in the Research & Development (R&D) stage of drug processing makes the system automated, secure and prevents the quality-assuring protocol from data breaching and modification attacks.

articleTitle: Person Re-Identification (Pre-id) in Blur, Low Light, Low Resolution Surveillance Videos: Object Detection and Characterization of Sequences
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Person re-identification (Pre-id) aims at matching an individual across different cameras, time and place. Pre-id has moved from an image-based system to a video-based system and datasets are moving from closed datasets to real-world surveillance videos. Collection of datasets and annotating them is one of the challenges. Deep Learning (DL) outperforms conventional feature extraction and matching methods used for Pre-id. Cloud platforms such as Google Colab ease out the burden of huge resource requirements of DL algorithms. Problem with pedestrian detection, classical object detection is at the root of Pre-id. This paper focuses on Pre-id methods trends in datasets and annotation methods and providing information at-a-glance. It further discusses pedestrian detection using Deep CNN architecture for differently characterized sequences and tries to correlate the results with model and sequence. The results outperform the detection task. It achieves detection of all, except maximally occluded persons with an average probability of more than 90% in varied situations. This paper contributes to establish a foundation for the next task of Pre-id. It compiles datasets and annotation information at a glance along with the information on methods and trends in Pre-id.

articleTitle: Optimal Face Recognition System using Haar Classifier
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Human beings when born are adorned with a presence that helps them to differentiate among other individuals around ie. “Face”. Alongside speech and fingerprints, A face is significantly used in biometrics as no two individuals have the same face. Myths though say that in this world you may resemble with some facial characteristics to 7 different individuals then these facial detection and recognition algorithms help us to identify between them. Facial expressions detection, face detection, and recognition have been impactful in the research domain especially in fields of image processing. Although it might sound like a cakewalk though undoubtedly it has proven to be a complex task for a computer to detect and pose all the features of the image passed since various other variables impair the accuracy/confidence of the algorithms mainly illumination variation, the background noise of the image, low resolution, occlusion, blurriness of the image, pixel scale of the image and many more components.Considering these myths, this research is based upon face recognition algorithms and a model to identify if there is a face in an image passed, identify the number of faces, and justify with confidence value obtained which algorithm should be suggested, is most optimum for face detection and recognition among (Haar classifiers, default face recognizer, Local Binary Pattern Histogram (LBPH) face recognizers, {Adaboost algorithm}, Eigenface methods, etc.). This research particularly focuses on the use of Haar cascades and the LBPH Face recognizer algorithm as a hybrid combination for the smart voting system as an authentication approach.

articleTitle: Study of Unknown Five parameters of Single Diode Model of PV cell and PV module using Analytical and Optimization method with different manufacturing data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Recently researchers are searching new renewable energy sources. The alternative source of energy search by researchers is solar energy. Solar energy can be converted in to the electrical energy and that is the device Photovoltaic (PV) cells. With this consideration mathematical modeling and equivalent circuit is used to calculate known and unknown parameters. In this paper we have discuss about comparative methods such as analytical as well as PSO optimization techniques by using manufacturing data among the different PV modules by identifying the unknown parameters such as photon current (Iph), diode reverse-saturation current (Io), diode ideality factor (A), series resistance (Rs), shunt resistance (Rsh) with known manufacturing data. This data also compare with different references. Along all these method we have studied about characteristics behavior of PV models that is Current-Voltage, Power-Voltage characteristics.

articleTitle: Minimal Satisfiable Product: A Novel Concept in Agile Project Management for better adherence to Customer Requirements
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Digitization of manual tasks and processes leads to the introduction of business scenarios that are addressed through software products and ERP solutions. To co-innovate with a business to produce the next generation business application is a challenge. Understanding the end-user requirements is often considered daunting as it is chaotic. The real needs are often hidden, and adoption rates of such applications are always under question if the quality and usability aspects are not considered.
